Many have watched the genocide unfolding in Gaza ignorantly, as if the event had no precedent in world history, and as if humanity had no opportunities to learn crucial lessons from the failures of our ancestors.
In fact, we have walked this road before, always with devastating consequences that too many came to recognize only too late.
### **Even American 's most "progressive" state has an ugly history**
The genocide of indigenous North Americans [continued in California](https://substack.com/redirect/61781753-4e8c-4aaa-ad59-6f85874c430b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) well after it had already been completed across the rest of the country. For a state with such a supposedly progressive reputation, the brutality of California's past is remarkably [recent](https://substack.com/redirect/6b85be0b-98c4-40d5-8177-166668707604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In the wake of the discovery of gold in 1849, legions of prospectors and settlers flocked to the west coast, which had previously been a backwater. By then, the major cities of the east had all been established, but California was still relatively wild.
[Acts of brutality](https://substack.com/redirect/61781753-4e8c-4aaa-ad59-6f85874c430b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) suffered by innocent people over the ensuing decades ranged from multiple outright massacres to a policy placing bounties on the heads of any native Californians. Children were stolen from the families for "re-education," not unlike those forced in the torture camps of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia a century later.
[From 1909 ](https://substack.com/redirect/c7233836-33a6-4884-ae3a-e93ce864b701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[until 1979](https://substack.com/redirect/c7233836-33a6-4884-ae3a-e93ce864b701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[, California adopted a policy of forced sterilization](https://substack.com/redirect/c7233836-33a6-4884-ae3a-e93ce864b701?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--now widely recognized as an abuse of international human rights. It was applicable to not only indigenous women, but even beyond the end of their civilizations, also to Black and Latina women who were either incarcerated or resided due to disabilities in state institutions. 20,000 women were forcibly sterilized under that policy before it was officially suspended, yet the practiced has continued elsewhere in the United States [at least until 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/db9534a5-2a83-4b16-964b-34effb848a94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
If you've learned something from my writing, don't stop! Subscribe for more. Subscriptions are free, although paid subscriptions help expand my work.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..klfrCV8rgxxxrcs6h3hC4qZsWWtFwm6L8uPCGlEbsuA?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=138321163)
The last pocket of indigenous Californians was a family of four from the Yahi tribe discovered by settlers [in 1908](https://substack.com/redirect/74512d05-7276-418c-b531-bc64db2c3c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They were attacked by prospectors, and fled into the wilderness, where all--but one--died before revealing himself in 1911.
In his culture, people spoke their names only after another member of the tribe had introduced them first. That's why the last indigenous Californian, [Ishi](https://substack.com/redirect/6b85be0b-98c4-40d5-8177-166668707604?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), was named by settlers using his tribe's generic word for "man."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a883a890-6efb-42d5-ae04-0cda4e02c8cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Ishi in 1916. Image from Wikimedia Commons.
Ishi ended up working at the University of California as a janitor. [He died in 1916](https://substack.com/redirect/d8f9dc05-1c55-46ae-b7db-df40d638affa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), at the side of a UCSF doctor who befriended him. His last words were, "You stay. I go."
### **Overlooked parallels**
The forced sterilization of Black and Latina women, using the policy crafted originally as a genocidal strategy against indigenous women, is just one illustration of how human rights violations tend to expand if left unaccountable.
History offers any number of further examples, from 400 years of ruthless European colonialism around the world, to the last 250 years across the U.S.
While California's genocide continued until 1916, the same--or [even worse](https://substack.com/redirect/ba6d5bc0-2efe-4f20-9576-0c91882cbd57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--brutality can be observed across America generally. This country was created by the theft of land and a relentless genocide so severe that it later [inspired](https://substack.com/redirect/862a8441-b752-40ea-baf3-de1b065c492e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Nazis, who [reportedly](https://substack.com/redirect/3254e0a0-358d-4626-a065-f0e51593c22f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found American policies (particularly the "one drop" rule) too extreme to replicate.
### **Not so different today than before**
Surprisingly, the generally shameless _New York Times_ published [a powerful oped yesterday](https://substack.com/redirect/a2e7e275-e176-46cd-bc3b-cd867400657a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Palestinian-American psychologist and author Hala Alyan posing the provocative question, "why must Palestinians audition for your empathy?"
Her question has a disturbingly straightforward answer: as indigenous people, Palestinians are the latest in an entirely too long line of communities whose humanity has been denied by oppressors seeking their resources.
Israeli officials have made comments in the past week likening Palestinians to "[animals](https://substack.com/redirect/84028204-accc-4475-8735-b505991369db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," while Israeli _journalists_ have referred to them as "[savages](https://substack.com/redirect/b4db1054-25a0-4710-b5a6-5d8a44f83469?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
Somehow these people managed to get their jobs without seemingly having ever read a book. And they call themselves the civilized ones!
Nothing separates their--I'll just come right out and say it: evil--descriptions of Palestinians from Columbus describing Tainos in the Caribbean as savages, or American settlers treating indigenous North Americans as if they were simply obstacles on the path to industrial progress.
In fact, all people share the inherent human dignity that the world once came to recognize and defend...that is, until the United States [abandoned the international human rights regime](https://substack.com/redirect/e43d6cd2-8756-4c39-8215-aa14ce4d5d00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and drove it into the gutter.
After doing so much to [destroy the principles for which our nation once fought a World War](https://substack.com/redirect/ae8c7447-bc21-48f6-a10b-0268087e598a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Washington is now exporting that regime of lawlessness around the world.
Having been silenced after running for office on a platform including Palestinian rights, I rely on readers to work around restraints imposed by social media platforms. Please share this post with anyone who might learn from it.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=138321163&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTM4MzIxMTYzLCJpYXQiOjE2OTgzNjQ4ODQsImV4cCI6MTcwMDk1Njg4NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.TK4bkkFOC7mmhpyyfjxThcJufiYULTe-7E13_Lvx-7U)
### **No empathy? Your own interests are implicated**
Concerns for human rights draw on sources far beyond empathy or altruism. In fact, indigenous peoples have held keys to environmental sustainability that their oppressors--industrial societies--need increasingly desperately.
The world is finally coming to recognize the priceless incomparability of indigenous wisdom, particularly in the context of managing natural resources that industrial society has managed to either squander or alternatively destroy in wanton ignorance.
For instance, native Americans practiced [forest management techniques](https://substack.com/redirect/d61ef8f3-a842-42ba-a9d9-288d5c3b84c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) far more advanced than the "modern" policies that drove the West to catastrophic wildfires for the past decade. Similarly, indigenous communities in South America have offered priceless wisdom about the incomparable effects of plants, whether as [medicines](https://substack.com/redirect/8d9b0d2f-6723-4468-83c5-4a3f53a548bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or agents of [exploring consciousness](https://substack.com/redirect/8f33565e-5747-4297-97c5-3824ef0e5c65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), previously unknown to scientists.
Many observers forget that the conflict in Palestine has [more to do with land and water](https://substack.com/redirect/ea0a26ea-fc46-4808-9632-e5feb96eab0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than it does with religion. That's yet another result of the propaganda masquerading as journalism across the United States.
Paid subscribers can access a series of poems by Palestinian authors that I've collected, alongside one of my own that I put to music in 2017 to help expose the parallels between life in the West Bank and the Black experience in the United States...

**Well, I have one message for the GOP: not on my watch. I will never stop fighting for the right to reproductive choice.**

| | | [ ](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_yl1Uj6BXJ24eOiILcksZzKI_X7T4Jt8MpjQsQdQXVrbSvgHKp_Rr_rI6VrVZddHMg&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorsements_mathis_231026&n=1)

Dear Friend, I launched my campaign only last month, and yet the support and endorsements have been pouring in. It’s humbling and motivating. This week, **Assemblyman Devon Mathis** (Tulare) endorsed my candidacy to represent the North Coast in Congress. A fellow military veteran, Assemblyman Mathis’ endorsement comes on the heels of endorsements from the Sonoma, Humboldt, and Marin County Republican Committees. Asm. Mathis represents portions of the Central Valley, which is the breadbasket of our state and the country. Similar to the North Coast, water security is a top priority for Central Valley residents, farmers, and businesses. He also serves as the Vice-Chair of the Agriculture Committee for California as well as Vice-Chair of Water, Parks, and Wildlife. This endorsement further confirms the urgency of securing our water for the future. Water is a local, state, and national issue. Water insecurity in California would devastate not just us, but the nation and the world, which relies on California agriculture in many ways. On that front, I’d like to share with you an op-ed published in the Marin Independent Journal on this very issue. I pose an open question to our current representative in Congress, Jared Huffman: Why should Californians have to pay $500 million for less water storage along the North Coast? You can read the entire piece here: **[Marin Voice: Huffman opponent has water supply questions for congressman](https://nb.christocongress.com/r?u=dEApTJqefsu-4_2xIW-SgL_CzkFlmQb1UIpYS1ktp4YCv1RCGZ9D7AAljdRwJWBV5s4HwkrRtFG8TMvLguTqYbg5dClUqWHvucl4hTvs1N_qXc6K_9eCeBO1Faq7mLj22iOsOKob_HRkhOH4o0uwxw&e=826a47930363a3c7550ba96ed32bd779&utm_source=christocongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=endorsements_mathis_231026&n=2)** As always, thank you for your support. Semper Fidelis,
**Chris Coulombe**
Republican Candidate for California’s 2nd Congressional District

Service has always defined my life. I joined the United States Marine Corps in 2001 and became a military police officer.

After 9/11, I was assigned to Marine One to serve and protect the President of the United States.

When I completed my military service, I graduated from college while working full time and raising a family. But my urge to serve hadn’t gone. I continued to serve my community as a pastor and as a non-profit leader.

**Now, one of the greatest honors of my life is being able to serve as the Mayor of my hometown of Stockton, California.**

As Mayor, my team and I have revitalized our local economy, attracted businesses that have created jobs, balanced our budget, tackled homelessness, and reduced violent crime.

America as a whole is suffering these same problems, but the politicians in the White House and Congress don’t have what it takes to fix them.

body:
Last night, a gunman with a history of mental illness and easy access to a weapon of war walked into a bowling alley and a bar, shot and killed 18 people and injured 13 others.

Friends -
Last night, a gunman with a history of mental illness and easy access to a weapon of war walked into a bowling alley and a bar, shot and killed 18 people and injured 13 others.
It was the 10th deadliest mass shooting in modern American history and the worst since the shooting at Robb Elementary School in Uvalde last year.
And you want to know something else?
Literally hours before the shooting, the U.S. Senate voted to pass an amendment allowing veterans found mentally unfit to still be allowed access to guns.
You can't make this stuff up.
Listen, there are some issues in Washington, D.C. and states across the country that are tricky and tough to fix.
This one isn't.
The data is clear, and it is conclusive: states with strong gun laws — like California — have lower per-capita gun homicide and suicide rates. States with weak gun laws have higher gun homicide and suicide rates.
So if Congress won't act...
And if the courts prevent states like California from doing what has to be done to save lives...
**Then we need a Constitutional Amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence.**
My state — California — was the first to adopt a resolution calling for one. Now we need 33 more.
Will it be easy? Of course not.
But will it happen? I believe it will and that we are on the first ones on the right side of history.
I am committed to making sure similar resolutions are introduced, and passed, in more states across the country. If you think that is a fight worth fighting, I am asking for your help today:

| **Newman Mayor Casey Graham Endorses
Congressman John Duarte**** **
---
| | **Modesto, CA – **Newman Mayor Casey Graham proudly endorses Congressman John Duarte for re-election. Graham was elected to the Newman City Council in 2014 and was elected Mayor in 2020. Mayor Graham is a veteran with a law enforcement background focused on making the city of Newman a safer place to raise a family, live, and start a business.

Mayor Graham released the following statement regarding the endorsement:

"Congressman John Duarte has been an outstanding Congressman for his constituents in the City of Newman, CA. He and his staff have been readily available and involved in our community from the time he was elected. His efforts for our community and the area are greatly appreciated."

"I am grateful for Mayor Casey Graham's endorsement," said John Duarte. "Mayor Graham is a local leader committed to improving public safety and economic development in the city of Newman. With his support, we will continue working to ensure that Central Valley families have a safe place to live and more well-paying jobs to get ahead."

Mayor Graham joins a growing list of community leaders, elected officials, businesses, and organizations endorsing Duarte's campaign to Congress. John continues to earn support districtwide because he is focused on the issues that matter most to Central Valley families, not partisan politics. John is working to make the cost of living more affordable, lower taxes, and protect our communities from rising crime.

Please visit [www.johnduarteforcongress.com](https://johnduarteforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d614871a572868b235b65477d&id=a9ac5cd12b&e=76a47b375f) for more information about the campaign.

subject: Heidi's 2023 Voter Guide Inside + New Episode of Unleashed!
body:
12 days until election day... VOTE with your VALUES!
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-r/) Hi Peter, This week on Unleashed, I am putting out a very important speech I did at Charis Bible College a couple weeks ago, all about embracing faith and speaking truth in a world that often feels hostile to our values. It couldn't be any more important than RIGHT NOW, across the world. We're seeing attacks on people of faith, and it's time for us to stand up, speak out, and vote our values. It's time to make your voice heard, inspire your community, and embrace the power of faith in the political arena. **As you go into the rest of the week, I challenge you to ask yourself how you can take ONE act of faith.** Tell a friend or neighbor how the world's current events are affecting you, share your faith with someone new, give your pastor the book [Letter to the American Church](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-y/), send this [podcast episode](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-j/) to someone who might see things differently than you and start a conversation... if we all just took one small step, imagine the impact we could make, friends.I've provided a link below where you can donate to Israel's hospitals, troops, survivors, and more. Maybe your act of faith is donating to our brothers and sisters in Israel who need our prayers and any support we can offer. My heart goes out to all those affected by this horrible act of terrorism and I pray that we all feel God's healing, peace, and comfort. [DONATE HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-t/)
### **Episode #20 - FAITH TO FREEDOM:
SPEAKING TRUTH AND VOTING YOUR VALUES**
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-i/) [WATCH ON YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-d/) [WATCH ON RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-h/) [LISTEN HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-k/) [READ HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-b/) _Not into podcasts? I post transcripts of my monologues and full episode breakdowns every week on my Substack.[You can subscribe here!](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-n/)_
### **Only 12 more days until the 2023 Elections! Here's where I'm focusing my time and efforts to win back our state...**
I will NEVER stop stressing the importance of LOCAL ELECTIONS, and we have some big races and ballot measures being decided in just 13 days! I encourage you to focus on 1-2 issues you really care about and go ALL IN the next two weeks to get across the finish line. Donate, volunteer, door-knock, share on social media, tell all your friends and neighbors... Below are some of the people and issues I'm focused on this election cycle:
### **STATEWIDE ⤵️**
❌ [**NO TO PROP HH**](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-p/) ❌
### **LOCAL ⤵️**
❌ **Douglas County School District: **[Vote NO to 5A and 5B](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-x/)
**✅ Douglas County School Board: **[Best DCSD](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-m/) \-- Maria Sumnicht, Jason Page, Andy Jones
**✅ Woodland Park School Board: **[Cassie Kimbrell](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-c/) _,_[Mick Bates](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-q/) _,_[Dave Illingworth](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-a/)
✅ **Aurora City Council: **[Stephanie Hancock](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-f/) and [Jono Scott](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-z/)
✅ **City of Aurora:** [Mayor Mike Coffman for Re-election](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-v/)
✅ **City of Pueblo:** [Randy Thurston for Mayor](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-e/)
✅ **City of Lakewood:**[Don Burkhart for Mayor](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-s/)

### **Switch your spending to an America-first, family-owned, patriot-backed manufacturer.[Click here](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-g/) for more info!**
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-attidky-tkwdjuidt-w/) Keep your eyes peeled for a bonus episode with one of the candidates listed above coming out this week! Have a great rest of your week, friends. Democrats are finally seeing our border issue for the full-on invasion it is – everyone except Joe Biden. | It may be no surprise to you, Fellow American, but Democrats are finally seeing our border issue for the full-on invasion it is.

For years, Republicans have called on Biden to do something... anything to alleviate our southern border. Only recently, Democrat Mayors in sanctuary cities like New York City and Chicago have said that it’s now escalated to where it will “destroy their cities.” **The border crisis has already been destroying America.**
* Biden didn’t even visit the southern border as President until January of this year.
* Border states like Texas have bused **only a fraction of the hundreds of thousands** of migrants from the southern border to sanctuary cities like New York, Washington D.C., and Chicago.
* **A record-breaking, over 7.2 million illegal immigrants** have crossed the border since Biden took office.

[**SAVE OUR BORDER**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=ff80dfa7ef1b49f5afea4ebfcf7b3031&_e=Nthr_lSx8dbpDwOLKy_fmuG6t2VX5Nr-1GbeUblGmAVYYkDpVtLqsEKSrIzA28IdNOMv9D4cSjG5NZL7Nrcv2JXe5HOCG2FkPVdzhoDFYU1AbepvkXTiP4SEP0TADKbCjfZEetyqUKMcvdkRTsb3YJRrdYiUGZ2HWZ8E0uvSKbPZrW_NtXbowiHCU-fVSGlL2bk7ZSPFUUhVRrHNipZTidgdu7P_SuQBl1WOwdYZnpe_RbUdUHCRHD5ktsz1J7cLx44leVZixqvPzKDGM-sR7WUuCa2ydpzyr-BV7xoXIXEWf97PoJKJxyyPsPdI4Szh8SsYyUB-YKfUq5pyhCHaOjE6ibA-5_SOLPqunJSo2GFzSj6vGytwb1PUoNKN9dkuh4upXgrtvep4weCPrJ77SOdjxYVdhGmYj_oVDcwdt54Hb0SAT__1ScHaJuB7WhPa)

body:
Democrats are finally seeing our border issue for the full-on invasion it is – everyone except Joe Biden. | It may be no surprise to you, Fellow American, but Democrats are finally seeing our border issue for the full-on invasion it is.

For years, Republicans have called on Biden to do something... anything to alleviate our southern border. Only recently, Democrat Mayors in sanctuary cities like New York City and Chicago have said that it’s now escalated to where it will “destroy their cities.” **The border crisis has already been destroying America.**
* Biden didn’t even visit the southern border as President until January of this year.
* Border states like Texas have bused **only a fraction of the hundreds of thousands** of migrants from the southern border to sanctuary cities like New York, Washington D.C., and Chicago.
* **A record-breaking, over 7.2 million illegal immigrants** have crossed the border since Biden took office.

[**SAVE OUR BORDER**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=58262a2293d84e918b7c930c8c96a8de&_e=rDJ62iCKqBnEAfHHwwc99pg4iVhRxafG6KWSNxbFWtXQsDzb0_NngwEpS9jUlW3bTprk3u7wX_lqQqUa--euidG4ntixsUmbbtxasE9RUlH5dBbre3BLfiyyiOYi9GwjByAna9ZSR33UfPCmHKh6BVIzQIL-Vd0FBqba69Jcdc5FVBf2G7uaFxU9PzwmGA6lIeWo-20NAOTxKLjWzBOVSy6kmDBg3bOzw8tEz3TjzRRPrx_Jvf7sd9uY1Zyc6zg-S0qgleuViiaoWxSBukxLyyG2PgNRpR0kFtI6FMwXoV3bgJkwARwoV-qEzuvzwOJL_yg9D9qsihA7t8HCxJEGbLsLobwqXVYJbuS9iYSdJqW0j4WnA2SPLDIiRKAZyTvwHrWm8z6_vZQdSV0sFDu3efVzUBG-v_9uKsfbcU9L8_6ERoYn3aCtm8l9X6t5mOggYQLIBBw60auR4Uz4Pr9NUA%3D%3D)
This is beyond insulting to our dedicated Border Patrol and military who are risking their lives on a daily basis at our wide-open Mexican border – and to the American taxpayers who foot the bill for it all.

**Fellow American, the only people to blame for this border invasion are Joe Biden and the Democrats at the federal level who refuse to act.**

I write this having just been elected by my colleagues as the 56th Speaker of the United States House of Representatives.

The task of leading our House majority is a great one, and to say that I’m humbled by the faith my colleagues have bestowed on me is an understatement.

body:

income inequality is rarely considered. Is income inequality
actually increasing?

Dear
Friend,
There is
a lot of talk these days about the idea of income inequality.

While
these two words are often repeated, the actual impact of income
inequality is rarely considered. Is income inequality actually
increasing? What about poverty? More importantly, is all income
inequality necessarily a bad thing?

Hoover
Research Fellow David Henderson addresses these urgent questions
and more in his thought-provoking new commentary for the Hoover
Institution, Income Inequality Isn't the Problem.

From
showing how income inequality could be a good thing in the right
circumstances, to showing from the data that poverty in America
is actually on the decline, this brief but thought-provoking
commentary is truly a must read, if you care about our nation's
future economic success.

Friend, I
invite you to read what I think is one of the strongest counter
arguments to the prevailing rhetoric on this hot-button issue
today.

Simply
click here to request your free copy of Income Inequality Isn't
The Problem right now.

Thank
you,

Greg

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. subject: We desperately need your voice!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

| [ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3eab543fd4424a7b91cb9876834563b7&_e=xkjO6m0iJgSPDkug4a2KSNlxYNko2lDgPROBdSR3HKEjXkEYd0s7mKFSI6TBBkudwud0toBOdbvNfiAQ7QXm0DOM0T-trDZM-ngwQzbRFRDeaouIKvkdY5bKYjxGIRBn3sM-RBv2u7t6_5mDCIYTJF5LKWq2er9gBKAiExBrhNrthtPCOsiFEKK7TYz-7dXlEJ_2W62iaYOUs8oLnE2Pf176jt2zZ_cTjmXbuabyFPqS9nVvmw59-49O0c89s1F1t35clZj4Vlq9HU0sNS0YSLwBBLpKr_ZzlY8olVMGKEAydoy7gB1XPfztGGg0I1VOc_IvzBJHxuWRISalgUZIvy1ydpKze_l-uQrtC5c4DTVcqfRs5Ne93t0SqHe7qrTfTMm_WrpviSwXwiJMtPAkhA%3D%3D)
---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3eab543fd4424a7b91cb9876834563b7&_e=xkjO6m0iJgSPDkug4a2KSNlxYNko2lDgPROBdSR3HKEjXkEYd0s7mKFSI6TBBkudwud0toBOdbvNfiAQ7QXm0DOM0T-trDZM-ngwQzbRFRDeaouIKvkdY5bKYjxGIRBn3sM-RBv2u7t6_5mDCIYTJF5LKWq2er9gBKAiExBrhNrthtPCOsiFEKK7TYz-7dXlEJ_2W62iaYOUs8oLnE2Pf176jt2zZ_cTjmXbuabyFPqS9nVvmw59-49O0c89s1F11Ph_TCLu1Hg4xN9kAIldnBLSyVSqdaz5aBG7gX_LaKGFcXtHFIH1n4GUaMQL1YSIoHHOoYSM56yIA_M3JvxmXa7iQl_JyE3cQsXrjD9YLfmlT4uFAW5kZNFxW8FOlzSMt9hOSv4S2hBti-9IWsnXvw%3D%3D)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3eab543fd4424a7b91cb9876834563b7&_e=xkjO6m0iJgSPDkug4a2KSNlxYNko2lDgPROBdSR3HKEjXkEYd0s7mKFSI6TBBkudwud0toBOdbvNfiAQ7QXm0DOM0T-trDZM-ngwQzbRFRDeaouIKvkdY5bKYjxGIRBn3sM-RBv2u7t6_5mDCIYTJF5LKWq2er9gBKAiExBrhNrthtPCOsiFEKK7TYz-7dXlEJ_2W62iaYOUs8oLnE2Pf176jt2zZ_cTjmXbuabyFPqS9nVvmw59-49O0c89s1F1omOwyHIxUmOl4W4ozagVcQL7gYQHaDLpaPRDIKVqZ7TCYuCXL06l0TDg9XS_BVg7WCDTNnb1xnioLaZJ4Qud1T_A6lHTUCVNnlSmocRPUBmgEZtEDoNSH9ITifOivG4pgQ3cWV2ZMGqjN7OI_6Zn7w%3D%3D)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser

name: The Flyover
subject: U.S. Strikes Iranian Weapons Facilities, CNN Issues Correction, and NASA Sees Face on Jupiter

## U.S. Strikes in Syria, Israel Ramps Up Attacks
Two American fighter jets [struck weapons and ammunition facilities](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O8yAQAJ8Gd1iwgH8KF1_jLl97pUXMkuyFQASbWHn706W-ejTSaL5O28lTonz57--4cCyb35leuGklYZRgNtuFJSICmg4XPcyT1Vo7010XF0KM53k02g5zHFFpawMEa4ybgp51RwsoMFrBqGbnlOsjjNMw6NGhAzOBElZhIC61_y6U-YoxvcsLa7-Xe5eWK_OjCfNPwCpgPY6jz-c949F-uYD1URIx7U3Amj1TyT7JhvuzEr8FrM8mG1e6YZNUfZaJ8g2DZF8vyE22dyUvK7JP9LFlqCWj9Mx-vzVZ9-w1gHauq0t4HJQStWEUVl3untKnkf9e9hMAAP__oi1vTw) in Syria last night. The targets were used by Iran's Revolutionary Guard Corps—along with militia backed by Iran—and the operation took place in response to a [string of attacks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQhX-N2YzOZwxkYOjClq4d0QFHcqnB1HaC8u8rOnd7enrS-_R9XYcriZft9kkrd3kJA01ZXjwY0NhotENVzN3CjGwL7kx9aStjjLPFvUMia5vWziPXy9hCPY0LXKyBabQEDRbSIaA1gA1cnANXLti0dW0axw5ti6Aq4FlyiOUjyJbvvPh3eHEsp7AWvrvnvCdlPxT2CvvjOMo9eMkyhXOgsN_4SAr780Vhb-DMTmGf-MWRvH7qpHMMYU868h5i1mMk2bRsj2d86yWGVVPONH0nfdaRfjRts07vKKQBDNqqdUXs5v0Q7yXVjargtpL4P8T8v7HfAAAA__-v9mtG) on American troops in Iraq and Syria. A Pentagon spokesman said that similar operations [will continue](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL8Gd0SwgHEKite4y2uvtIi9xHtHwIK9RPn7U66-ejTSaD4uyyVSpnL7H-8YONUlrkwPXLSS4CWYxQ5bSIiAZsCgx_NktdbODHuwTploNSCg2qzbEm7mqqybRuWvSY8DBVBgtAKvzs4pd0rgp3HU3qEDM4ESVuFGXNvps1LhHVN-1Qe201rvQw4789GF-SdgFjDzjjvl_GYC5qNmWl8CZiqMrUSmWmIWMFvw0wRWfne5E3dJLRaKRaa4UiYm7JKK7K9GUaaac31SucnIHNevLmt5i9xqPbqAeWhhO56UM_XRC6tu90i_BQP_PesnAAD__0kma_4) if attacks on U.S. forces do not cease.

In Israel, IDF forces carried out their biggest ground attack of the war, sending tanks and troops into Northern Gaza Wednesday night on a brief raid ahead of an expected ground invasion. [See video here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2unDAQQOGngW6QPWB-Coo0dJs2JRrsMUxiMLK9u9o8fZRb3_o0R9-vx_ogCXLtP-nkufi4ki3y4lUrwAGwXbvazZ4Zua151v00dlpr09bHrNyERMbqTVtuhx5xs5PZnGG1dUa7WmZU2GqFg5qMUabxOIx9rwfDBtsRVdUpdlJian5HucrBPnzii1Nj41mH-SjlzlX7o8KlwuXid27yn8__WOGSS0yfChfJiTjAQSdleFOCnf4S7Ck-LweJxMEm-865gFz2mbLEC6IHGy8fxBbIETwloAziPNyJb0qcYaNSAnvh4EDjNOE49HWa3f2WECT3Q9Wp_SQJX6_le7p_AQAA__9wLXHD) At the same time, Israel carried out 250 airstrikes, killing two Hamas leaders and releasing [video of the strike](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2z2yAQAH-N1KGB40NyQZHGndOm1FzEYV0MwgOMFf_7N371a3ebnf1zW2_IiY_7b8zkeywrbp1ftCopYBagVzMGH4mA9EheuctilFJWj7v_6xYNBqxUxkpwUiqjL5vanFE20hJG9iBBKwmzvFgr7RRhXpxTsyULegE5GEmBe6nTv8JH3ymmd3lRnbaSx-T33p9t0L8GuA5wPc9ziuX_QWf7-A8pNYUBrtwqUmKROXHH-haVEmGjJmIpHe8kkGvrlR8k-o5dPDglCqLRwaWKHTM2sZWc8QhUx-rD8-SUuLl5MPKekdN3Uf950FcAAAD__za4aOQ). The air and ground strikes marked the biggest day of activity since the war began three weeks ago. While Congress debates military aid to Israel, Florida Gov. Ron Desantis said Thursday he's arranged to [send drones, weapons, and ammunition](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFu7CAQAL_G7jjBLhgoKF5z3b02pYXNcibCYBl0VvL10aVOOZpmNB-P-eFTTuX53-_keqyzX3t60Sw4A80AZzkGF4mAcCQnJmukEELhuDmDxsqwoqG4LAt6IbkB69VCQUSEOCYHHFBw0NwqxdUtgjbTJLQiBWiAD5JTSL2et8-aSt8o5q_6ovO21n3Mbuv9aAP-G-A-wN0fha72Vm84e1ozDXAP1HzpqbFw1kKNXeSPWhprWzp2Kp2ldnrK7Om_PcNIIfBFolQKFh9QYLSCW9Q2RK7FeLpwXCnn1CY9SP7cfcq_Nf3vOT8BAAD___WtZMM) on cargo planes chartered by Florida.
## Ford Reaches Deal to End UAW Strike
The United Auto Workers [reached a deal with Ford](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L9uMjEQBPCnueuM1uu_V7j4Gjq-NuXJwWtw8J2RvQHl7SOo083o14zm47SeYqllv_yPGwXObY1nLg9aJQh0AtWq5xQyEZKaKUi7eC2lNGq-BkzWGGfjAlIZtSD4xSuVpXX4qVDCXAICKgnoYDEGzCGj89ZKZ8ig8giTBkqFWz98tbLzlXL9aQ_qh3Pb5hquzPcxqX8THic8xvtOz_GiV-lczpVe6ZubeLZ-oz7E4F5uNERuPYkL7dRjFVvj9jaqNe5chgAfvTSgkkPSOmnKUYPRS7ZeJxNx7iHdn6XWMqybNFy2WOp7FP_90W8AAAD__yBmZbM), a breakthrough toward ending the nearly six-week-old strike against the three big automakers. The UAW told striking Ford workers to return to their jobs. The agreement with Ford calls for a 25% general salary increase plus cost of living raises that could raise salaries to above $40 an hour. Union members must still ratify the agreement, but assembly workers will get an 11% raise immediately. GM and Chrysler parent Stellantis were [in intensive talks Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1uwyAURp8Gb1hwzY8zMHTxlq4dLRxfEloMEVzH6ttXztzx6FvOd76u89XHFPP902_oKJTZ3yi-cJaCg-UwzKpbXUAEHDp00lxGJaXUQ_dwizdBKuuXRYzeCwxozS1oq1SwMBjTRQcCBinAiovWQvcB7GiMtBo1DCMIpgSukUrtv0vM9MCQfssLa38rW5fcg-jZ2PDBYGIwHcfRV9wJazt3BtOyt5ixNQaT36k0TtXn9iyVPMWSGUyh1JUfpf5gbbwi7TW_ke_-4Cc1ft94I0zJZ4qNn8L8_G4YTF116_OIKcVmLFPivvmY3m70f6q_AAAA__-y5mv7), with the Ford deal as a template for their negotiations. Sources said the two sides could reach a tentative agreement by today.
## Maine in Fear as Hunt for Gunman Continues
Maine residents along the coast [remained in lockdown Thursday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGvpCAURn8Ndhi4CDiFxTZ2s-2WBuE6sotewyVj9t-_zKtf9xVfck7On-fyDLnk8_U7HDi1jZYQW37jopUEL8EsQ5emDRHQdDhp9xgHrbU13T5pMN6vG7jVj0qP0Q3WpHVNEaILaGOXJ1BgtAKvHtYq22_gR-e0t2jBjKDEoDDlRrX_S_lsO27lP72x9pGOrkx7axcL80vALGC-77u_KjLvWENJn4-A-UMQMGv12U7AfIXaWNImj5wiBW6yUPyHSSa6T8lxJyosYyHGJMORk2QMNe5yoyoL3pkbnfIIzJJ3ooZVwNzVKV13LiWz82JQryPk8m3Zfo72FQAA__96sG49) while police launched a wide-ranging search for Robert Card, the gunman suspected of killing 18 people at a bowling alley and a restaurant in Lewiston Wednesday night. Schools, factories, and many retail shops were closed Thursday in Lewiston, Lisbon, Bowdoin, and other towns in what's known as the Midcoast area of Maine. ["Folks are simply terrified,"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtygzAQAL8GOjHS8RAuKNK4c9qUzIFOcBmBPNJhwt9nnDrVFtvs7NdjfCAH3pdP3GgQH0echV80Gq3AKqjHpnSDJwKqSxpMd-sbY0xbl-sAk0HUnbbaeNfhTID91LXYg7X6ZpqSB9BQGw1W39pWt5UH23edsS21UPegi0aTY4mp-o68y0o-XPFFqZrjVoZhFXnmov4o4F7A_TzPysefnc789gXcN3KMbyLvpOa4bcfOcqnEzgVyyhMmldcYhfdF5SM_aZaszpUS4RQPyWq7slC6FE45hkMoXEooJfYX70uZBvc8OQTOnS0avWzI4a9N_l_1GwAA__-hYG5u) said one local politician. The suspect, Robert Card, was a reservist in the U.S. Army and had been [temporarily committed to a mental health facility](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFzhCAUBOBfgx0OPEC9giKN3aVN6XD60JdBcADPyb_PmDrtbvPtfj2np6NAcf10O9rq0-TmSm-cpODQc1CTbhbrEQFVg1Z2j0FLKY1qNovolTdghvklHeqX8Y_BS5ydd4sWnW7IggAlBfTiYYwwrYd-6DrZGzSgBhBMC1yoptx-J4p1Qx9-0htzO6e9CXar9ShMfTAYGYzXdbUZz4q53P2dpBwWBuNZGIxHCjQjL3M6M98dReS7i7ykc90qD3hRqSny3ZXCy5ZSpbgWfgP5vbVjMDbZLsdFIVDpeqbFujsKf5b6_zW_AQAA___3M2Wk) over the summer for acting erratically. Hundreds of officers from various agencies are searching for him, including the Coast Guard and Canadian border officials.

| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18452b9e-5a67-484e-ae15-8a7a6710f6b9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._

| |

| | | | | Peter, Running for office is tough. You have to ask a bunch of people for money (like this), and then the other side gets together and says lots of mean things about you. Having a baby is tough, too. There’s lots of screaming and crying, poop gets everywhere, and you don’t get any sleep. Now that I think about it, it’s a lot like running for office... Peter, I’m writing because my friend and former Senate counsel Josh Riley is doing BOTH. First, I laughed and told him he was crazy. When I realized he wasn’t joking, I said I’d help! [Josh is running for Congress in NY-19, and his race could decide the House majority. Will you join me and split a contribution between Josh Riley and Blue Amp Action today to help him win one of the most important races in the country.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta06fc742-0015-4cf5-92cd-d3ba55527e65/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | | | [DONATE NOW](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te5d81636-6f34-40dc-8444-ac14fddba5b4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc53d3054-5b71-4dc5-945c-237b8c538001/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
(The really tall guy is Josh.) Josh is used to doing things the hard way. He grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood in Endicott, NY. When the local factories closed, Josh saw his community struggle – but he worked to put himself through school and graduated from Harvard Law. In the Senate, Josh and I brought Republicans and Democrats together to actually get stuff done (yes, it really is possible)! The bills we worked on together expanded rights for survivors of domestic abuse and provided new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. It wasn’t easy, but Josh got them signed into law. Now, Josh is running for Congress without taking any corporate PAC money. He knows it’s not the easy route, but it’s the right thing to do. But that means he’s relying on folks like you and me chipping in. And with his time spread thin between the campaign, the new baby and, ya know, still having time to breathe, he’s relying on us now more than ever. [So if you can, please split a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today. Josh’s race will be one of the most competitive in the entire country, and he’ll win it with our help.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2a0d300f-1e54-4fc0-a8d2-fd47d0a82df8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Please follow Cliff Schecter on Twitter @cliffschecter, or subscribe to The Takedown with Cliff Schecter on YouTube, to keep up to date with this battle for the heart and soul of our country.

body:
Did you get a chance to read our previous email?

At Shift WA, our mission is to keep you informed about issues that truly matter to our state, to help shift the direction of our state. We're dedicated to ensuring you have the latest news and updates for informed decisions that impact your family's future.

Throughout our history we've closely followed Washington Democrats' attempts to impose a state income tax on our state. The state Supreme Court recently helped them by redefining "income" to justify an income tax on capital gains. The Wall Street Journal just picked up on a legal filing that could send the case to the U.S. Supreme Court (only two weeks after our initial report on it).

When you read Shift WA, you can trust that you are getting the latest, important news, often before it gets picked up by mainstream news outlets.

Your support helps us stay your up-to-date source for state news. **_[Please consider contributing $100, $50, or $25 to help us continue our crucial work.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401099:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r)_**

Thank you,

The Shift Team
In recent years, we've kept you updated on the attempts by Washington Democrats to impose a state income tax, an issue that strikes at our state's very constitution. | | [](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401100:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r "Shift Washington")
---
|
Friends, We here at Shift WA are dedicated to keeping you informed about the issues that truly matter to people across our state. Our mission is to ensure that you are well-equipped with the latest news and updates, so you can make informed decisions and take action to shift the direction of our state. In recent years, we've kept you updated on the attempts by Washington Democrats to impose a state income tax, an issue that strikes at our state's very constitution. Despite voters rejecting such a tax multiple times at the ballot, we've unfortunately seen our state Supreme Court redefine the simple meaning of "income" to justify a state income tax on capital gains, a faulty decision which is being pushed to the attention of the U.S. Supreme Court. It certainly got the attention of the Wall Street Journal, which noted a legal brief filed with the court by the Washington Policy Center (just a couple weeks after we here at Shift WA shared it with our readers). As our readers know, Governor Jay Inslee played a significant role in the passage of a state income tax, starting with capital gains. Inslee and his fellow Democrats' attempts to claim the tax is an excise tax prompted the Journal to comment, "creativity and lawmaking rarely go together well, and sometimes they run up against the Constitution." The U.S. Supreme Court is currently evaluating the merits of whether "interstate excise taxes 'threatens to wreak havoc on taxpayers and businesses around the country,' as the Washington Policy Center highlighted in an amicus brief" to the court. Our commitment to providing you with insightful information is highlighted in the fact that the Journal could have just been reading Shift to find that quote, as we informed readers like you before any mainstream news outlets. **_[Your contribution today will ensure that we can continue our vital work, keeping you informed about state politics.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401099:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r)_** **_[Please consider contributing $100, $50, or even $25 today, so we can continue keeping you up-to-date on the latest news coming out of our state.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401099:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r)_** With your support, we can keep a watchful eye on developments like the state income tax issue and ensure that you are up-to-date as well. Thank you, The Shift Team P.S. Your contribution today will have a direct impact on our ability to keep you informed and empowered. **_[Please donate now to help us in our mission to protect our state.](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401099:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r)_** | [ DONATE ](http://click.shiftwa.org/ct/62401101:sUPNMkiLN:m:1:2610672541:9EE254D171A355F983F396C7853BAE8F:r)

# **A Message from the Chairwoman**
---
| | _**Bank Your Vote**_
---
Team, Wednesday night, I had the pleasure of attending the Reagan Bean Dinner in Fort Wayne. Allen County GOP Chairman Steve Shine packed the house with grassroots leaders from across Northeast Indiana to hear from our RNC Chairwoman, Ronna McDaniel. In her keynote address, Chairwoman McDaniel shared many important messages about growing our party and winning elections. None of Chairwoman McDaniel's messages were more important than the RNC's efforts to get our voters nationwide to ["bank their vote."](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/899b6d9ce476fc533947229f28c3afba/10d5326fc8009d48c3d6b838967d376c/40313 "https://gop.com/press-release/rnc-launches-bank-your-vote-campaign/") As the Chairwoman explained, we need to increase our efforts to get our supporters to vote before election day. As we have seen in some states, Democrats have outpaced Republicans in getting their supporters to vote early, and it has led to wins for the other side of the aisle. It is important that we start to put a larger emphasis on getting our voters to the polls early so we can not only bank votes, but we can then spend time and resources on expanding our electorate. If you live in a city or town with an election this fall, please take the time to vote early and bring your friends and family. Again, not only will this ensure that we get our supporter's votes banked, but it will give local campaigns and county Republican parties the flexibility to focus resources on increasing our get out the vote efforts by contacting only those folks that haven’t yet voted. As we head down the final stretch, [please take the time to find an early voting location near you](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/899b6d9ce476fc533947229f28c3afba/c4b74dceca277f90c3d6b838967d376c/40313 "https://indianavoters.in.gov/") and ["bank your vote."](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/f7f15e9875c39250df60ac364a9f256a/40313/899b6d9ce476fc533947229f28c3afba/c0ce279de4e8be4ec3d6b838967d376c/40313 "https://www.bankyourvote.com/") If you take the time to vote early, you will not only enjoy the convenience of skipping the long election day lines, but you will also be doing your part to turn out more Republicans than ever before!
---
---
Chairwoman Anne F. Hathaway
---

---
| | | Donald Trump has now been fined twice for violating his gag order, once for $5,000 and once for $10,000. That's a great start, but it's time to ramp up the punishment -- by sending him to jail. That's what special counsel Jack Smith has [called for](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tea577bdd-dae4-47e5-bad7-86ecb1fc0d05/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), and we couldn't agree more.

Trump is not above the law, and he needs to be held responsible when he attacks court personnel and puts them in danger. Any other defendant would be on their way to jail for the third violation, and Trump should be too.

[**Add your name, and tell the Trump judges "don't just fine Trump, send him to jail too."**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0f11e243-9c0f-473e-9609-cef9eb6a8546/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: We desperately need your voice!
body:
Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?

---
Pro-Life Advocate,

I'm writing to you today as a passionate protector of vulnerable women and the unborn. I know that you share my belief that every human life is precious and should be protected.

I've been a pro-life activist for over 20 years, and I've seen firsthand the devastating effects of abortion on women, children, and families. I've met women who have had abortions and dealt with the pain and regret as they navigate a deeply felt loss in their lives. I've met children who were born after their mothers were denied an abortion and who are now thriving. And I've met families who have been torn apart by abortion.

I know that you're also aware of the recent Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. This is a historic victory for the pro-life movement, but this was just the beginning of the fight. **_We still have a long way to go to ensure that all unborn babies and their mothers are protected from abortion._**

The first step is for pro-life Americans to come together and state what we believe and what we will do in order to protect the unborn. [Will you join me in standing up for the rights of unborn children?](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5406c9ee2257430d8fba3c7c06bb326f&_e=uv1MkEFsOZEFjtdVu8J4lXqeAwoyUfP2zGtH6WzoF5i473QSWNa34Y2F5upsUrp3HgtXierObbdEHR3w8zLJ6Xaw0wxH_kOQbK4_LaKOEk13ElORsgbEfFfdzCuM-j8RCMb5z_toj9NjirykJ5OlbgazZDF3_fbmt0KCLAUCE-v6A7s7SLNMPuw1dYWQKYjWYByqsV3RXOXmyH_jpkTq5gglwZIZAxbsQjf-7xKGjo16PcA6Z3RdU0ZxLbQlVbwFRtKtVkBj4PAYVBnZH-uN52hWwXHD12WQQcKF0v9z_nPWYOCvZqQhAt4TCCqEAhJvcoukycybyCqrh2aQXi6chpeAGa93cJSLrCvM0hL1VRH-uJ54at35mBpZVWHJeP5OZqlTm31LSlOtqFby9E0J2g%3D%3D)

When you sign the pledge, you'll be joining a growing movement of pro-life Americans who are working to make a difference. You'll also be receiving regular updates from SBA Pro-Life America about the latest pro-life news and events.
[SIGN THE PLEDGE »](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=5406c9ee2257430d8fba3c7c06bb326f&_e=uv1MkEFsOZEFjtdVu8J4lXqeAwoyUfP2zGtH6WzoF5i473QSWNa34Y2F5upsUrp3HgtXierObbdEHR3w8zLJ6Xaw0wxH_kOQbK4_LaKOEk13ElORsgbEfFfdzCuM-j8RCMb5z_toj9NjirykJ5OlbgazZDF3_fbmt0KCLAUCE-v6A7s7SLNMPuw1dYWQKYjWYByqsV3RXOXmyH_jpkTq5gglwZIZAxbsQjf-7xKGjo16PcA6Z3RdU0ZxLbQlVbwFTdC3nrfDJZrYxjNyfVV75HOP9-EQi_T6-MWbx86PY8VpYhoiGV8tCPxyGV6mWnfDuAL8J8BO4iiWbzozKYjLRkRF60T-uBnGprVl0IG10493csPDREPrKa-guEqAgymfTapFdMmDB7okmaQBQphPOg%3D%3D)
| **I know that you care about the unborn, the protections for mothers and their babies and I know that you want to make a difference. I hope you'll join me in signing the SBA Pro-Life America Pledge to Stand Up for the Unborn. Together, we can build a pro-life America where every child is welcomed and valued.**
---
For LIFE,

Marjorie Dannenfelser

# ▶️ Meet My Great-Grandmother: The Spirit of Immigration

Our nation stands as a beacon of hope and opportunity, founded on the dreams and contributions of those who sought a better life on its shores.
I'd like you to meet my great-grandmother, who arrived on American soil from Germany back in the 1850s:
[**In a moment, I'll share why immigration is such a deeply personal and important issue to me. But if you're ready to help make a difference and build a more inclusive America, chip in today**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=6573d487df&e=a2a46ff12c)**!**
[http://secure.actblue.com/donate/meetmygreatgrandmother](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=920d48cc63&e=a2a46ff12c)
[](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=e90165b127&e=a2a46ff12c)

As a candidate, I stand with the spirit of immigration, honoring the contributions of those who’ve made America stronger.
My great-grandmother, like countless others, embarked on a journey with the hopes of forging a brighter future, embodying the very essence of the American dream.
Immigrants from all corners of the globe have played a pivotal role in shaping the America we know today.
The strength of our economy thrives on the diversity brought by immigrants. This diversity not only bolsters our economic vitality but also mirrors the principles upon which America was founded - liberty, justice, respect, and dignity for all.
Unfortunately, anti-immigration rhetoric often strays from these core American values.
It is the right of families to stay together, and together, we will honor our history, embrace the present, and construct a more robust, inclusive America.
Let’s champion comprehensive immigration policies, keep families together, and uphold our American values of liberty, justice, respect, and diversity!

[**If you’re ready to be a part of our campaign and see that we have the momentum needed to flip Texas, please chip in today. It would mean the world to me.**](https://laura4tx.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=65529f44b849c16925ad85a66&id=44c917b513&e=a2a46ff12c)

name: Mike Johnson
subject: Let me introduce myself
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35603%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LEYc9Oq4ViTjM3uZD4fBGw&sysid=1)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35604%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bxPmmm0M7iSN1fUOq9chOg&sysid=1) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35615%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1vOjHxNSLPSEPyoK1haBnw&sysid=1)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35616%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=QRORM%2f6Fkd8h8C4JXOgbTQ&sysid=1)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35617%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=MRa6WbyJaeKnvKI1JLtC7w&sysid=1)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35618%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aN6YchHPdzjat72BRDWGgQ&sysid=1)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35619%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AMHsBcBSKj042iJaa2oZ7A&sysid=1)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35610%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=9loXE%2fOsMay6aq7%2f9ZHu6w&sysid=1)

[** CHIP IN > **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35611%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZOgXr7XJKzK7dk4Cthsoyg&sysid=1)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35612%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=VcgE2SpyywTiYdf2PMoLJg&sysid=1)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

[ ](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35603%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LEYc9Oq4ViTjM3uZD4fBGw&sysid=1)

Mike Johnson
Speaker of the House

| **_MIKE JOHNSON_**
* * *
Mike is a dedicated husband and father of four, as well as a constitutional law attorney who has devoted his life and career to fighting for the fundamental freedoms and traditional values that have always been a priority to the people of Louisiana.

[**WILL YOU STAND WITH MIKE?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c35613%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=l2CkngzDYLle9j9gp43xEQ&sysid=1)

subject: The cornerstone of leadership
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhmvr399h4riqm8r7qvjj4oj6it04nvl4u3jor90_)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zivf4j2cri8us4j6h5ao74987gvo7vp9i4q61220_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs5ebi4v5ftu8c233sb860b8sgn6agbogo2f2168_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9q2frq6ns6d6lb0evcjivvf9fsb3e8mblb5noi8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

[** DONATE TO SAVE AMERICA > **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuopqtb6dj8si6o5a1a9g2a0oc0ubm5c7eh2sfr0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it’s too late.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0dki74ak70fa3pam75tn08busn063tash4gr1s0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It’s why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It’s also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference – one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House – and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee.

We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, [**but we cannot do it alone.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmtgbfgsp09g36f30irq4o3q1d909fnksgdq5p78_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5h64ob1cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[**If you are committed to keeping the House from the radical Democrats who are self-serving and want to turn America into a socialist country, then I need your support today.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zvu8bkmauvcjq2v5dqtl16k6scn0v65ge7639edg_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5h64ob1cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

[** CHIP IN > **](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zugsl983uddo8h4oilf0sp1641166c8ec2p8b5e0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW.

We MUST act, and we must do so today.

[**Can you pitch in right now to help save our country, Fellow American?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkv78d9sho2jeuju794rg5raab8jl8qc48floc08_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl33c1g624p5e5qrfkbm6ni66o30c4aq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj2c5gm6oh5u)

Thank you for all you do, and God bless.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z222ij4jppuv36t684r6pl8oqt7mmd1uvp8iod3o_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5h64ob1cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqhhm0o312cin2tdnq5r3bp33c1g625d2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

---
# **Financial Freedom in America**
# **will soon be gone!**

**The 'Digital Dollar' is now a reality.** On November 15th, 2022, the Federal Reserve announced they are now testing the **'digital dollar'.** They'll be joined by major banks like Citigroup, HSBC, Mastercard, and Wells Fargo. **And you should be scared!** The 'digital dollar' puts all your money in the hands of the government. They'll be able to....
* **Know what's in your accounts and what you buy**

name: Mike Johnson
subject: How I lead
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY MIKE JOHNSON FOR LOUISIANA
body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z7o2khqbr0ecmsgk13cgvfbqj82duuqs936pe8t8_)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

body:
This request comes at a very important time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country.
#

Good morning, Peter,
I am reaching out today to humbly ask if you can please make a $3 contribution to my campaign for Senate today.
This request comes at a very important time for our campaign, for Arizona, and for our country. Please let me explain:
John McCain used to represent the Republican Party in Arizona. We didn’t agree on everything, but I respected him. He served our country honorably in the Navy. He was a good man and Arizonans were lucky to have him.
Today, Kari Lake is the Republican Party in Arizona. Someone who attacks our democracy at every turn. Trump’s loudest, biggest advocate. Someone who lies, spins conspiracies, and calls for political violence.
She’s dangerous, end of story. And she is the Republican frontrunner for the U.S. Senate in Arizona.
When she announced her campaign early this month the timing couldn’t be worse. We had fallen far short of our goals in September, which let Lake get the edge on us with her announcement, her endorsement by Trump, and the big checks that came her way in the aftermath. That’s bad news, because if she runs a strong campaign she could beat us. Really.
That's why I am writing to you this morning. I need your help. Almost all of our donations come in response to emails like this one. There's just no other way for our campaign to raise the money we need to win.

body:
Suzanne Crouch shines a light on the personal tragedies that made her a fierce advocate of those struggling with mental illness and addiction.

https://crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=24d1676bab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Out of the Darkness: This is my story (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=24d1676bab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
I'm committed to expanding Indiana's mental health services because, for me and countless others, it's deeply personal. We must provide help - it's a cause we can't afford to ignore.

My heartfelt thanks to Mary Milz and Indianapolis Monthly (https://www.indianapolismonthly.com/news-and-opinion/politics/out-of-darkness/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=24d1676bab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) for sharing my story.
https://www.indystar.com/story/opinion/2023/08/30/indiana-income-tax-bidenflation-suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/70707154007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=24d1676bab-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Article Preview:
------------------------------------------------------------

One morning when she was around five years old, Suzanne Crouch woke up in a tiny panic.

“Where’s mom?” she asked her dad.

“She went to see the doctor for her nerve medicine,” he replied matter-of-factly.

Though the little girl had no clue what that meant, her father didn’t seem worried. And so, neither was she. Crouch assumed her mother was sick and the medicine would make her feel better. To that point, when her mother returned home later that day, she seemed fine. Nothing more was said about the event, but Mary Crouch would return to the doctor’s office again and again.
It is unclear what “nerve medicine” the doctor prescribed. But we can guess it was probably something like the mild tranquilizer Miltown, which was widely prescribed to patients with anxiety disorders during the 1950s. A popular precursor to Valium, it was said to “calm the nerves.”

Nerve medicine, if you will.

For Crouch, the incident held little significance back then. “When you’re very young, you think every family is like yours,” she says. “It wasn’t until I was older that I realized my family was different than other families. Not bad, necessarily, but different.”

subject: I believe to my core

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z3ggdll3hdkhjk4vi8q926s9h8p01osvmafh1f0o_)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpkhf50jv3g9uvem4upuf739h1mn5fua3hnbl6ag_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfl4m2jap94p5e5qrfkbm6ni9c56liiaq4o32cpi60oj7ccin2tdnqprrasjm6kqu4t9jecin2tdnqmqj2d5lemquaddk6ior69bhemrtcd1lm1q39dpjmnh39dthqep238h1e8he4933cjge2oj7c3g61oh5u) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z8e7q003rpl9e4odrdnvvuhnuk1a39o8ihee9gq8_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5h6eo70c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support – to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9tfjtb4ea7813sqn9jqnph69ttj06bmq9ptc7vg_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5h6eo70c3h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnqib19lckicin2tdnq5r3bp4m2jap95d2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch5u)
