# Resume Speaks for Itself
There is not a single candidate in this Republican Primary for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District that is more qualified to be your next Congresswoman.
Not a single candidate. There is only one candidate that understands the Federal Government like I do. See for yourself.
[**Once you’ve finished reading my qualifications, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a73f81c4b5&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=f7e9d815d7&e=0a12281e0e)
I served my country and left for the United States Air Force in 2005 and served as a Medical Logistics professional. During my time in the Air Force, I deployed overseas during the Global War on Terror campaign, serving within the [**Task Force Medical**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=634a5ae5d4&e=0a12281e0e) and the [**Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF)**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=68446eca00&e=0a12281e0e)**(yes, the BTIF was the primary detention facility for terrorists in Afghanistan)** in Bagram, Afghanistan, during the Operation Enduring Freedom campaign in 2007. After my tour of duty, I was honorably discharged in 2010, having earned numerous accolades for her service, including the National Defense Service Medal, Afghanistan Campaign Medal with 1 Service Star, Global War on Terrorism Expeditionary Medal, Global War on Terrorism Service Medal, Air Force Expeditionary Service Ribbon with Gold Border and 1 Oak Leaf Cluster, and NATO Medal.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a5dad7e56e&e=0a12281e0e)
Following my military service in 2010 I transitioned here the the 6th District to the Frederick area, where I continued my career in Medical Logistics as a Federal Employee. While I am no longer a current Federal Employee (I resigned in 2021 before my first campaign for Congress in 2022), I held various federal positions working for the United States Army at Fort Detrick, supporting the Department of Defense’s Medical Supply Chain Process.
I mainly served as a Program Manager tasked with managing the Army’s Medical Logistics Program in the wholesale procurement, production, introduction, sustainment and recovery of Medical Sets, Kits and Outfits (SKOs) and individual medical equipment requirements for the entire Army’s deploying medical force. I rose to the federal position of GS-14 **(equivalent to a Major or Lieutenant Colonel in the military)** before I decided to resign my Federal Position and embark on my next journey to serve my country in the United States House of Representatives.

[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e9d961d790&e=0a12281e0e)
Today I work in the private sector **(yes, I still have a full-time job to provide for my family)** for a government contracting company that specializes in Health Science, Health IT, Health Service Support, Supply Chain Modernization, and Facilities Management, as well as automation best practices and governance within the Veteran’s Administration and Defense Health Agency. My company’s broader experience extends to supporting the Department of Defense as well as providing IT services to enable our customers’ IT missions. My main focus within my current position is to work on Business Development and Proposal within the Supply Chain Modernization efforts throughout the Department of Defense, Department of Veterans Affairs, and various other Federal Agencies.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=8f50f6d1fd&e=0a12281e0e)
I don't say all of this to toot my own horn. I say this because we are at a crossroads in this country, and we need to pick up winnable seats for Republicans, like Maryland's 6th Congressional District.
The success of our party depends on our ability to identify and support individuals who can lead with wisdom, integrity, and dedication to always uphold our American values & traditions.
We need to elect Republican candidates that can actually win seats like Maryland’s 6th district.
**But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.**
[**Will you chip in with a donation today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=911a42eab3&e=0a12281e0e) ⬇️
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong again.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b4a5f41465&e=0a12281e0e)

| | | Tanya Chutkan, the judge overseeing Trump’s case on his attempts to overthrow the 2020 election, recently issued a gag order on Trump, limiting what he can say about Special Counsel Jack Smith and the case. It was the right decision, and a courageous one! But Judge Chutkan then paused the order at Trump’s request after he filed an appeal. Since then, Trump (predictably) has resumed posting attacks on social media about potential witnesses in the case. [Trump’s gag order needs to be reinstated immediately!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T34f6f584-61a7-44f9-a2c6-09f37c274b66/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) He must be held accountable for his attempts to intimidate those connected with the trial. The witnesses and the people working on the case deserve to be protected from Trump’s threats and lies. [Sign your name to urge Judge Chutkan to reinstate Trump’s gag order immediately >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a0f4230-aafc-45b3-86f7-d43b515ecc49/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Peter, we get it. You have a lot of emails in your inbox asking you for money and that can get exhausting, especially in the fall and winter months when you’re starting to think about the holidays and the 2024 elections seem so far away. A real person wrote this email, so from us to you, here’s why these emails are so important:
1. Because early money makes a HUGE difference to campaigns like ours. It’s what allows us to get ahead on getting Michelle’s message and vision out to voters long before Election Day — and that kind of early voter outreach matters!
2. Because this campaign isn’t just a campaign, it’s a movement — it’s about all of us coming together to support the movement to flip TX-15, take back the House, and make the American Dream possible for everyone in South Texas.
3. Because we know that not every person who opens this email is going to be able to donate — but we also know that when you have the means to support the movement, we’ll be able to count on you.
4. Because all eyes are ALWAYS on fundraising numbers. It’s what shows the power of this movement.

**[Right now we’re staring down our next End of Month Deadline in just 4 days, and we’ll be honest — we’re not where we need to be. That’s why we’re asking you to chip in whatever you can right now. | | THIS WEEK RURAL AMERICA AMERICANS UNITED kicked off its first media campaign, to formally introduce ourselves to the people of Washington State. The campaign is the first step in our [innovative plan](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=dktmAqaJu9NZT8GfSOP-2cYPUkzUzZUht2aZzsUdVhg.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kcml2ZS5nb29nbGUuY29tL2ZpbGUvZC8xeUtEd1p2TzJyRFhTdDQ4WTNES3dzY3k1a3V1VHc3cVgvdmlldz91c3A9ZHJpdmVfbGluayIsInIiOiIxYTgwMmYzYy1hNzcwLTQ2ZWQtYjNkMS0xZWRjOWMxMDBkMzAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) to turn the center of the state purple. Starting this week with a $350,000, 14-month media blitz, RAU will blanket the 4th District with 20,000 separate radio spots highlighting traditional Democratic Party values. The radio ads, in English and Spanish, are believed to be the largest public awareness campaign ever launched in the state. At this time, with right-wing messaging dominating public discourse, we estimate that 80 percent of the Central Washington population has never heard a positive Democratic message. We know it’s going to be a marathon, but this campaign will begin to change that. Along with advertisements, we have started a program of outreach to local newspapers, TV and radio stations, podcasts and blogs, beginning with our first news release, which you can read [here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=RUF9yrPx0aZlgbSm1UwRhGypPMvQMKPoTNb2wbi_gZA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kcml2ZS5nb29nbGUuY29tL2ZpbGUvZC8xZEw2T2pycDRXMDFTS2ZxY2ZYTFg0VFBtT1E2N1N5RTIvdmlldz91c3A9c2hhcmluZyIsInIiOiIxYTgwMmYzYy1hNzcwLTQ2ZWQtYjNkMS0xZWRjOWMxMDBkMzAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ). We will be following up on the release with personal visits to newsrooms around the district, to introduce ourselves and our program to journalists who for years have been spoon-fed Republican propaganda. Just as we were finalizing the news release, the 4th District’s venal Congressman Dan Newhouse blessed us with a perfect example of why Central Washington is so sorely in need of organizations like RAU, which can provide residents with what may be their first exposure to core Democratic values. Newhouse, who clearly doesn’t believe himself in any way accountable to his electorate, voted several times to choose bullying, election-denying Jim Jordan to be Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives — an office that is next in line to the presidency in the event the president and vice president are sidelined. (Fortunately for all of us, Jordan lost.) Jordan, as you know, is a far-right extremist who has been accused of [ignoring hundreds of sexual abuse claims](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=dFIXne3ZsLLSH0DVtYbqE1WMysn17ZPvGeONS2KoxwA.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudGhlZGFpbHliZWFzdC5jb20vZXgtb3N1LXdyZXN0bGVyLWFkYW0tZGlzYWJhdG8tc2F5cy1qaW0tam9yZGFuLWNhbGxlZC1jcnlpbmctYmVnZ2luZy10by1kZW55LWFidXNlLWNsYWltcyIsInIiOiIxYTgwMmYzYy1hNzcwLTQ2ZWQtYjNkMS0xZWRjOWMxMDBkMzAiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) against Ohio State University team trainer Richard Strauss when Jordan was an assistant wrestling coach at the school. He was also among the leaders of the failed fascist Republican plot to overturn the results of the 2020 election. Let’s watch and see if he gets indicted. That Newhouse could vote for such a despicable human as Jordan to serve as the third-highest elected official in the land says a lot about Newhouse’s values — or lack thereof. A simple question we’d like to hear Newhouse answer: Is Jim Jordan the kind of man the people of your district should have as a role model for their children? In other RAU news ...

| | Thank you Yakima Herald Republic for putting a spotlight on the exact issues that RAU will be working to combat. The Herald wrote: "School board members, for instance, aren’t supposed to be carrying out political initiatives — they’re supposed to be laser-focused on one thing: educating students. A fire commissioner’s guiding principle should be protecting district patrons’ safety and property, not advancing a social agenda. It’s basic civics. But apparently somebody needs to review all that down at the [Yakima County Republicans](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=iGOI_HoV7J4c-Rxp8o1ZyKmGeE06fzJNfNeOpb2xVqo.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly95YWtpbWFjb3VudHlyZXB1YmxpY2Fucy5jb20vP3Y9NzUxNmZkNDNhZGFhIiwiciI6IjI3OGI1OGUwLTY0ZWEtNDY4Mi1hYjVmLWZlYjcwOTRhYTM4NyIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjI3N2U3ZjRhLTAwZTMtNDhmYy1iYjk3LTY1NGIzZmEzNzRhOCJ9) office, which seems to have a coordinated strategy for seizing control of as many local boards as possible." To read the full editorial click [here](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=i5mPbRMMNDi4oJKajPi5ExBVPlh_KpaalP0vsvXydFQ.)[.](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/95OjnV7Wj/c?w=i5mPbRMMNDi4oJKajPi5ExBVPlh_KpaalP0vsvXydFQ.)

body:
I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life.

|
[](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm46msil6r74iajsg1i3fuflorb6j6lhm0hb4c5g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfkahae9iasblmv8ncdf1a59p4pd2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7cejm79r48d245p25oh4cdie1ob6c1hmep324no)
---
Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I’ve devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zigt6ouopr9pvsg9ilrgttbmhq9iqinln56lsr38_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgeppef9t6ekr3asjl6ejn9ctiekoj79hnmmrqbd5mmkpbfc5jmprr7dt26irrb83k6mh7fpjm6nh60oj6chg64or7qm99f44jipbp75ul2kbt0l0nq8a9f5uiak9lfkahae9iasblmv8ncdf1a59p4pd2c1h6cp30c9jm69bhemrtcttle9r3adf2ekpn69bhemrtbd9h6iqnbdf56mq39cdj4lonbdum6gqr0t1kmsprbohkmuot7ch1k8gn48n24hhm9o71cpg66pr4c8iv0) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhfe7h2bs6fgoj9j05jtlqtd5edjcl8o8qcblbqg_rp22sh2s8i66p70s5j60or7chh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuj7adhle9qj79rkmep7ac9jkorrbdt5mirbaclnm2prcttjmuh39dtlk1q3b8jnspr3boj0c9j68o32cdjtb4kni29pclsjivaha5ugagbt454niv95a4qnq58l74p5e5qrfkbm6ngl2ksicmh60oj6chg64pr34lonbdumeuqn4thl6nh7acrj4lonbdulmkoj9dblmnijbd1km6piasblmvb38ddgegqbectls8qbfcejm8iv0)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

Right now, in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It’s the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Peter, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we’re running out of time. I’m not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. The path we’re on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. **SCHOOL BOARD ELECTION SPOTLIGHT**
On November 7th, you have the chance to save our schools and oust the extremists from America's classrooms. And here at the 1776 Project PAC, we're seeing more momentum than ever in the mission to protect parents and students, providing the resources and support necessary to combat the corruption inside the classroom.
[DONATE](https://substack.com/redirect/df8b82a0-c3fe-4759-b666-974b8552094a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
And we're seeing it in state after state.
For example, in New Jersey [a recent poll](https://substack.com/redirect/14afbda2-b825-4312-82fc-517710387846?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) found that a whopping 76% of parents want to have a say in what their kids are being taught in school. That means school boards need to answer to parents and hold themselves and their faculties accountable for what happens in their districts.
And out in Ohio, there is a major battleground in the fight for parental rights. So if you're in Franklin, Ohio, make sure you get out and vote on November 7th for an incredible slate of candidates.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8562e0c0-13dd-4f21-b658-6499afb6bb21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In Kansas, we've already seen major success in getting pro-parent, anti-woke, candidates elected. And in the Chanute School District we have endorsed top-notch candidates who will be on the ballot.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0b671da9-fe1e-47da-8952-cd4fc7e514f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And in Virginia, districts like Loudon County have become the center of the parental rights movement. But it extends far beyond Loudon, as we have made key endorsements in Goochland, VA, who are committed to getting it right for parents and students.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ea5e9b13-2f32-451b-ad59-894b9280dd4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
We'll have even more candidates to spotlight in the run-up to the November elections, just two weeks away. Because the fight is far from over. And every week, we're exposing more and more lunatics who are trying to destroy education.
For example, in the Northshore School District in Washington, an extreme, unhinged, anti-semite named Han Tran is running for school board. She has a history of posts calling for the genocide of Jews is Israel. This the the madness we need to stop.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bc378d49-2ff6-4f88-8bbe-e6305784f7b7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
So get involved, stay engaged, and get out and vote. We are a true grassroots movement with an average dollar donation of around $27. And this quarter alone, we've raised nearly $700,000. These funds are going directly to restoring sanity to our school boards and destroying the pronoun mafia, the CRT cabal, and the America-hating radicals who need to be shown the exit doors.

name: LTC(R) Christian Castelli
subject: It's Official! It's Go-Time!
body:
Peter

It's official. The new congressional lines have been approved. And I am continuing my mission to represent the people of North Carolina in the new 6th Congressional District.

Your support in the past has been profound. I need it one more time. And I need it now more than ever.

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

_I 'm Christian Castelli. My military service includes 22 years as a decorated soldier, Green Beret, and senior advisor at the Pentagon._

It's no secret; America is confronted with challenges.

The answer to these challenges:
* DO NOT choose another politician DC Elite who just can't wait to get back to the swamp.
* DO NOT choose a politician who has run for three different offices in as many years.
* DO NOT choose a politician who broke his promise to keep a term limits pledge.

We face a War on Freedom by terrorists, calculated strategies to undermine America's interests, an unsecured and vulnerable border, and an economy saddled with inflation that is choking middle-class families and small businesses.

My purpose and motivation for seeking the Republican nomination is simple: _We need experience, and we need decisive conservative leadership._

Sending another politician to Congress will fail. Again. It's go-time!

**If you want a representative with real-world, real-life experience, then join me. Please send a contribution of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, or whatever you can today. **

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/donate-today)

R. Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired)
U.S. Army Special Forces
Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives

My military service includes 22 years as a decorated soldier, Green Beret, and senior advisor at the Pentagon. It's no secret; America is confronted with challenges. The answer to these challenges: DO NOT choose another politician DC Elite who just can't wait to get back to the swamp. DO NOT choose a politician who has run for three different offices in as many years. DO NOT choose a politician who broke his promise to keep a term limits pledge. We face a War on Freedom by terrorists, calculated strategies to undermine America's interests, an unsecured and vulnerable border, and an economy saddled with inflation that is choking middle-class families and small businesses. My purpose and motivation for seeking the Republican nomination is simple: We need experience, and we need decisive conservative leadership. Sending another politician to Congress will fail. Again. It's go-time! If you want a representative with real-world, real-life experience, then join me. Please send a contribution of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, or whatever you can today. R. Christian Castelli Lieutenant Colonel (Retired) U.S. Army Special Forces Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives (336) 810-8100

Earning the confidence and support of community members, leaders, and business people is what distinguishes Maria Montero--she reflects the people, values, and work ethic of the 7th Congressional District in Pennsylvania.

This week, we are pleased to share the support of former Republican Pennsylvania Lt. Governor Candidate, James Jones. Mr. Jones is a Conservative business leader whose run for LG expanded the base of the Republican Party. Maria is the new face of the GOP and she represents a key to grow our our party amongst the 55,000 Latino voters who live in PA's 7th Congressional District. Many Latino voters are shifting toward the Republican party and Mr. Jones knows Maria is the best candidate to beat Susan Wild. "Maria has the charisma, Conservative values, and real-world experience to win PA-7. I have been on board with Maria since Day 1, I believe in her, pray for her, and know that the future of our Conservative movement depends on us electing Maria Montero for Congress in PA-7". Thank you James for your support!

subject: Weapons of war don’t belong on our streets.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS ACTION FUND
body:
Period.
#
Derek: A simple message today.
The right will tell you that it isn’t guns — it’s people.
They’ll tell you that their rights can never be infringed — while working around the clock to limit the rights of others.
They’ll tell you whatever they need to so they can distract us and get the news moving past what Wednesday’s events were — a heinous act, and a preventable one.
We can never let them normalize this.
As Veterans, we’ve carried these weapons. We’ve trained with them. We’ve used them in combat. And we can tell you, without any doubt: Weapons of war don’t belong on our streets.
Period.
**[If you agree, add your name to join us and tell Congress to pass an assault weapons ban.](https://act.votevets.org/signup/231027_vv_em_ww_pet/?source=em231027-1-30?refcode2=17874.3013755.C3rEiT&akid=17874%2E3013755%2EC3rEiT)**

Mike Johnson is an election-denier who supported the insurrection on January 6th.
He’s also fought against same-sex marriage, wants to completely ban abortion nationwide, and has come out in favor of slashing critical programs like Social Security and Medicare.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As the only Palestinian American member of Congress, Rashida’s voice and
lived experience are more critical now than ever. But in response to her
leadership in calling for a ceasefire and an end to the genocide unfolding
against millions of people trapped in Gaza, Rashida has been under
relentless attack.

In some of their first business since electing a new Speaker of the House,
Republicans introduced a resolution to censure Rashida, with even some
Democrats joining these right-wing Islamophobic attacks:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231027-rt.2BdxRv&refcode=em20231027-31549&amount=3&t=1001&akid=31549%2E1203867%2E9bc4O- ]Newsweek: Marjorie Taylor Greene Gets Democrat Support to Punish
Rashida Tlaib

Marjorie Taylor Green's unhinged resolution is full of dangerous lies and
distortions. It isn't just Islamophobic and bigoted, it also attacks
non-violent Jewish anti-war activists.

Last week, Rashida spoke at a rally in Washington, DC organized by Jewish
Voice for Peace and IfNotNow, and an interfaith prayer vigil and rally to
hold the political establishment accountable for continuing the drumbeat
of war that will lead to more lives lost, especially children in
Palestine.

At the rally, Rashida reminded us that we must not lose our shared
humanity. The cries of the mother in Gaza who lost all of her children in
the unrelenting bombing by the Israeli government are the same cries of a
father who listened to his daughter being attacked by Hamas not knowing if
she is alive.

It's time to come together, and fight for this country | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/fffa4dda2d34/im-announcing-my-run-for-congress-12659137?e=c982eb7ad4)

---
| |
Congratulations to our new Speaker of the House of Representatives, Rep. Mike Johnson!

It’s now time to get back to work and continue our fight to protect our values from the Left. Our cause is vital, and I look forward to joining Speaker Johnson in Congress where I will not stop fighting to protect _**our values, our people, and our freedom. **_

Our opponents are fighting too, and while **the Left fights to destroy our values** , our representative _**fights only for himself.**_ Gonzales is happy playing politics in D.C. _while our people pay the price_ , and he will continue to let the Left get their way, as long as he can get his.

You deserve better. You deserve a leader who will **fight for our values** , who will **fight for our country** , who will _**fight for you**_. _**I will be that leader**_ ... I promise you that as your Representative, you can count on me, but until I get there, _**I am counting on you.**_

**Together** , we have a chance to save our country, **will you join me today ****Peter?**

name: Eugene DePasquale
subject: 5 years ago today
disclaimer_text: Paid for by DePasquale for AG
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72292601/434882693/-531765509?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTE3NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjQ1NTllNS1lMTc0LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qbfQIbxbchsFjm8pIVla9PiSDiwqucrUwgUDfsM9q-o=&emci=92ac8f70-2474-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=0f4559e5-e174-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=10203249) Team,

Today marks 5 years since 11 innocent lives were lost in the shooting at Pittsburgh’s Tree of Life Synagogue.

That attack was personal to me. I grew up in that neighborhood. The people in that community helped shape who I am today. It was a shocking attack for a close knit neighborhood that I know is full of so much love and kindness.

We have a responsibility to remember what happened on that tragic day. To mourn those who we lost, and to condemn antisemitism in all its forms. This comes as a stark reminder during a week when we have heard of yet another tragic mass shooting in Maine.

These attacks are an assault on our humanity. An attack on our values. An attack on the way we live our lives.

**Hatred, bigotry, and violence have no place in Pennsylvania.** As your next Attorney General, and as a life-long Pennsylvanian, I will do everything in my power to continue to fight against hate crimes and intolerance.

But listen, research shows that antisemitic incidents have only increased since the Tree of Life attack — a reality that hits closer than ever in the wake of the horrific violence in the Middle East.

This breaks my heart, but the resolve is clear. It’s a reminder of the duty that we have every day to do better.

To work harder to be more accepting and more loving towards one another. To remember our humanity. And to fight for a better, inclusive future.

Thank you,

Eugene DePasquale

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
| | | Hi team, It’s Col. Mike Waltz. I wanted to take a moment to update you as we begin to count the hours to our October end-of-month deadline.

After a lot of conversation with my team, we’ve set the ambitious goal to raise $10,000 before our end-of-month goal in just four days.

**But right now, we’re only at 6% of our goal for this end-of-month deadline push.**

[**Will you chip in $3 or whatever you can to help ensure we keep Michigan blue in 2024?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231027-1-15&t=2&akid=752%2E135344%2EFCfmc1)**

Here’s why Michigan could flip from blue to red next year: Michigan is a notorious swing state, and we know that in a swing state, sometimes you swing. This open Senate seat gives Republicans one of their best shots at flipping a seat that could help them take back control of the Senate. So, despite Democrats’ success last year, we know that Michigan will go red under the right conditions – and we can’t leave anything to chance in this race.
With a presidential election on the ballot as well, this election cycle is especially susceptible to that pendulum: The public polling released so far shows that not only is our race currently neck-and-neck with 14% of voters undecided, but a potential match-up between President Biden and former President Trump is unfortunately a dead-heat. That means we have not only one, but two tough races to win here in Michigan next year.
So, what does this mean? For us, the big takeaway is that we can’t take Michigan’s success for granted. That’s why we’re doing the early work to ensure a strong foundation for success down the line. We’ve been taking our message directly to voters early by visiting towns all over Michigan and meeting with folks to talk about the issues that matter to them. And we will continue to meet with people in every corner of our state.
But these early on-the-ground efforts have to be matched by grassroots energy. This is why Elissa always says that the most important time to donate is now: Early support helps us be strategic and intentional about how we’re reaching voters -- and ensures we’re having the critical conversations as early as possible.

body:
Like millions of Americans, this group of Senators has been personally affected by someone’s struggles, or our own struggles, with mental health. And we are ready to tackle the mental health crisis impacting people across the country. |
#
Hi there, Today, I want to write to you about an important new caucus I helped create in the Senate this month: **The Bipartisan Mental Health Caucus.** Like millions of Americans, this group of Senators has been personally affected by someone’s struggles, or our own struggles, with mental health. **And we are ready to tackle the mental health crisis impacting people across the country.** [I’ve openly shared my story of depression before](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72294936/434890763/-97434910?refcode=AU_TSM_FR_GEN_NOA_AC60_20231027_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzgxY2VjYi1lNTc0LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_PYaXIELBTXes2hx_h7Zb_eYnrhOpPAxpMyRowDmKkE=&emci=4d81cecb-e574-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=5381cecb-e574-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=6227932) — because I want people to know they are not alone. Millions of Americans live this story, either themselves or through someone they love and care about deeply. It’s time to destigmatize talking about mental health and start taking meaningful action in the Senate to help people who are struggling. We have a moral obligation to extend a helping hand to those who need it, those who need help but might not ask for it, and those who might not even know they need it. We can and must take action to address the mental health crisis — and I look forward to sharing the progress we make on this important, personal issue. Finally, I’ll leave you with this: If you or someone you love is suffering from a mental health issue, know that you are not alone. And I’ll be fighting to get the resources and help that people need. — Tina | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72294937/434890764/1669815119?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&refcode=AU_TSM_FR_GEN_NOA_AC60_20231027_AM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTU1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzgxY2VjYi1lNTc0LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_PYaXIELBTXes2hx_h7Zb_eYnrhOpPAxpMyRowDmKkE=)

name: Dan Steiner, PreBorn!
subject: Sign this note of support to an expectant mom
body:
TheFederalistWire.com

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Pro-Life Friend,

Will you help to encourage a young mom at a crossroads to
CHOOSE LIFE today?

I truly believe that young moms facing unplanned pregnancies
must be met with hope … an offer of life … and the
opportunity to hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

At PreBorn!, we lead the nation in empowering women by offering
compassionate, Christ-centered pregnancy and postpartum care.

Last year we saved more than 53,452 babies and led 9,544 women
to Christ!

Will you do me a favor and sign a note of support to an
expectant mother? My goal is to get 53,452 notes signed - one for
every baby we saved in 2022 - to share with women who come into
our 200+ PreBorn! Network Clinics.

Sign a note of support to an expectant mom

Abortion is the greatest humanitarian crisis of our generation.

One abortion occurs every minute in America, and more than
1,600 abortions occur every single day.

Not content to watch lives created in His image destroyed,
PreBorn! has boldly charged forward and grown from a fledgling
non-profit to the nation's single largest pro-life organization
in just a few years' time.

And how did we do it?

By God's grace, we have found a more effective way to "open our
mouths for the mute" (Prov. 31:8).

While the abortion debate rages in state legislatures and
courtrooms, we take a different approach: leading the nation in
empowering women facing unplanned pregnancies by offering
compassionate, Christ-centered care.

And we want to invite you to join us in that life-saving,
eternity-impacting work. There is no greater joy than saving a
preborn baby from abortion and giving a mom the opportunity to
hear the Gospel of Jesus Christ.

Please join PreBorn! today to send a note of support to a
future mom at one of our PreBorn! Network Clinics. Your loving
support and testimony of God's love can make the difference in a
mom-to-be choosing life for her preborn child!

Sign a note of support to an expectant mom

All that PreBorn! does is motivated by a desire to see the
Gospel of Jesus Christ transform the lives of mothers and their
children.

Our PreBorn! Network Clinics even receive an evangelism
training program to equip them with the tools required to move
beyond the fears and misconceptions of sharing the Gospel.

We put an enormous emphasis on prayer, which, I believe, is the
reason we lead the nation in the number of clinic visitors who
come to know Jesus Christ as their Savior.

Prayer is powerful. Jesus hears us.

Pro-Life Friend, your prayers and your love - shared through a note of
support - will make a difference to a future mom at a crossroads
today.

Please join us in praying for the thousands of moms-to-be and
preborn babies who will find hope, love, and a bright future
through PreBorn! and our PreBorn! Network Clinics.

We praise God for His intervention on behalf of these women and
their children -- to Him alone be the Glory!

Choosing life,

Dan Steiner

PreBorn!

PO Box 78221

Indianapolis, Indiana 46278-0221

Ever since, even as the nation suffered a terrible border crisis, the Department of Defense has sat on 20,822 unused border wall panels. | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72296028/434894573/2045957508?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTA2YzY0ZTEtZTc3NC1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hbr570eKEAYlxjKgTwFm1nnKd5uRuemchHYVsKueHmk=&emci=de9fa1cf-3774-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=906c64e1-e774-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=10481059)

| | Hey Peter — On the heels of a month punctuated by frustrations with Congress — both for failing to get meaningful progress made to keep the government open _and_ the mess the in-fighting within the Republican caucus has caused with the Speakership — it's hard to understand why anyone would want to join their ranks. **For me, in these moments of turmoil in Congress and abroad, I always revisit my 'why.'** Much of my 'why' begins at Markham Middle School, in Watts. I started teaching fresh out of college, guided by the Jewish value of _Tikkun Olam_ – heal the world. I was eager to work on the front lines to build a better, and fairer, world – and what better way to start than by educating and inspiring the next generation? And to be sure, **my students were everything we'd hope to see in our nation's future: hardworking, caring, brilliant, creative, and full of energy.**(In the interest of full honesty, I'll admit that managing a classroom full of energetic middle schoolers didn't _always_ feel like a gift, but that's on me.) But for all their promise, so many of my students struggled. Often because they were also facing issues well out of their control: income inequality, difficulty accessing health care, racism, food insecurity, environmental injustice, housing instability, a broken criminal justice system, and of course, underfunded public education. **So I became a lawyer, and later I ran for the LAUSD school board to push our schools to better serve**** _all_****kids in Los Angeles – to remove the obstacles adults have thrown in their way.** But the trouble is bigger than Los Angeles. Every day, all of America's systemic problems show up at Markham Middle School and hundreds of others like it. I've long thought that **if our elected officials focused on supporting those kids and creating opportunities for them to learn and to succeed, our entire country would be better for it.** But the old guard in Congress lost sight of my students long ago. It's time for new ideas and new folks to lead the fights that _matter_ – not for political parties or corporate interests, but for the kids I was lucky enough to teach, and their families, and the millions of kids just like them across the country. **I'm running for Congress to lead the fights that matter, Peter.**[**You can help me get there by chipping in $13 before our end-of-month fundraising deadline.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72296029/434894574/1183499175?refcode=2023-10-27-eom&recurring=&amount=13&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=906c64e1-e774-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTA2YzY0ZTEtZTc3NC1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hbr570eKEAYlxjKgTwFm1nnKd5uRuemchHYVsKueHmk=) [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72296030/434894575/1183499175?refcode=2023-10-27-eom&recurring=&amount=13&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=906c64e1-e774-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDQxNjIiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiOTA2YzY0ZTEtZTc3NC1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hbr570eKEAYlxjKgTwFm1nnKd5uRuemchHYVsKueHmk=) I know I'm not alone in this mission. clean_body: Why would anyone want to join Congress right now? | | | | Hey Peter — On the heels of a month punctuated by frustrations with Congress — both for failing to get meaningful progress made to keep the government open and the mess the in-fighting within the Republican caucus has caused with the Speakership — it's hard to understand why anyone would want to join their ranks. For me, in these moments of turmoil in Congress and abroad, I always revisit my 'why.' Much of my 'why' begins at Markham Middle School, in Watts. I started teaching fresh out of college, guided by the Jewish value of Tikkun Olam – heal the world. I was eager to work on the front lines to build a better, and fairer, world – and what better way to start than by educating and inspiring the next generation? And to be sure, my students were everything we'd hope to see in our nation's future: hardworking, caring, brilliant, creative, and full of energy.(In the interest of full honesty, I'll admit that managing a classroom full of energetic middle schoolers didn't always feel like a gift, but that's on me.) But for all their promise, so many of my students struggled. Often because they were also facing issues well out of their control: income inequality, difficulty accessing health care, racism, food insecurity, environmental injustice, housing instability, a broken criminal justice system, and of course, underfunded public education. So I became a lawyer, and later I ran for the LAUSD school board to push our schools to better serve allkids in Los Angeles – to remove the obstacles adults have thrown in their way. But the trouble is bigger than Los Angeles. Every day, all of America's systemic problems show up at Markham Middle School and hundreds of others like it. I've long thought that if our elected officials focused on supporting those kids and creating opportunities for them to learn and to succeed, our entire country would be better for it. But the old guard in Congress lost sight of my students long ago. It's time for new ideas and new folks to lead the fights that matter – not for political parties or corporate interests, but for the kids I was lucky enough to teach, and their families, and the millions of kids just like them across the country. I'm running for Congress to lead the fights that matter, Peter.= = I know I'm not alone in this mission. Already, thousands of people have joined our movement, and we're growing every day. Together, we can elect a Congress ready to make the bold changes our communities deserve. I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. My dad was a doctor and my mom was president of our local YWCA. They taught me the importance of hard work and serving one's community, and I've done my best to pass these values on to my kids and grandkids. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter. But I'll be honest with you: Over the years, we've seen more and more of the manufacturing jobs Ohioans have depended on for decades shipped overseas. Corporate profits have skyrocketed while workers' wages remain stagnant. Jobs folks used to be able to count on to support a family and save for a decent retirement just aren't paying off the way they used to. **That's why I'm fighting every day in the Senate for the Dignity of Work – all work. No matter what kind of work you do, I promise to fight for you. clean_body: | Peter — In a moment, But first, can I share my story with you? I grew up in Mansfield, Ohio, in a community of ironworkers, carpenters, autoworkers, and electricians. My dad was a doctor and my mom was president of our local YWCA. They taught me the importance of hard work and serving one's community, and I've done my best to pass these values on to my kids and grandkids. Today, I live in Cleveland with my wife, Connie, and our two rescue dogs, Franklin and Walter. But I'll be honest with you: Over the years, we've seen more and more of the manufacturing jobs Ohioans have depended on for decades shipped overseas. Corporate profits have skyrocketed while workers' wages remain stagnant. Jobs folks used to be able to count on to support a family and save for a decent retirement just aren't paying off the way they used to. That's why I'm fighting every day in the Senate for the Dignity of Work – all work. No matter what kind of work you do, I promise to fight for you. But I need your help: I'm up for reelection in a state Donald Trump won twice, and I can't win without folks like you by my side. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation to Sherrod Brown and Tammy Baldwin will go through immediately: | | | | Republicans are only two seats away from flipping the Senate, and experts at Politico say it could all come down to Ohio. Even worse, Mitch McConnell has personally named me one of his top targets, and I'm already facing three GOP opponents – which means three times the resources spent on attack ads against me. Now, polls show this race is neck and neck. So, Peter – I've told you who I am, why I'm in this fight, and what I'm up against. With the future of Ohio, and the Senate, at stake, I'm counting on your grassroots support today. Are you with me? Thanks for taking the time to read my story and for being a part of my team. Together, I know we can win this thing and keep making vital progress for workers and families. With gratitude, Sherrod P.O. body:
| | | Friends,
I’m writing today to share some thoughts in the wake of yet another horrific mass shooting, this time in Lewiston, Maine. First, I want to acknowledge how traumatizing these events are, particularly for those of you that have been personally impacted by gun violence. Please guard your own mental health and know when you need to take a step back, turn off the news, put down your phones, and temporarily disengage.

It is easy to feel overwhelmed and exhausted in moments like this. I would be lying if I said that I felt any other way right now. Everytime I find myself in this headspace, I know I need to focus on my why: my own three kids, and every child in this country who deserves to grow up without fear of gun violence, in all its forms. Our children are voiceless, and we must be their voice.

It's why I ran for Congress, and why I didn't just give up after I lost. It's why I started Their Future. Those of you who have been with me since the beginning know that I am not easily deterred. I will not back down from a fight just because it is hard, or because it requires personal sacrifice. Please know that I am more committed than ever to keep fighting for the world our children deserve. If we keep going, I know that together, we will do just that.

Until the kids are alright,
Annie
---

| | The moment after Speaker Mike Johnson was nominated, he led the Republican conference in prayer.
And the moment after he was sworn in as Speaker, he passed a resolution to stand with our great ally Israel.
_**The Bible commands us in Psalm 122:6 " Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee."**_
But sadly right now, there are members of Congress who are praying for Israel's destruction.
This is Congressman Ronny Jackson. I'm overjoyed that our new Speaker proudly stands with the nation of Israel, and that he's determined to defeat the radical Democrats who want to see Israel on fire.

|
[ ](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=405abf69febd4c98b288f47f8652fc49&_e=EVo-iVcOG2y5dyaMcSJgxMSyaKlPJ3isQpYTwuI-CM8VLmX0ZeWys0lwYu9VBS2sJrekaD26rVfyiZtLBxmN7EULktu0FtWnA8mzQjYUqLJsMNI-jwJhCX_vgA4ug9YPucEv-zRBFEKt0eaCPzw6tGHSlXbNVg3m9DZLSG98h_pIkP35x-BHVH7ZIFOzALeGp3TjwGe17Ngh-L28RVSQWteNp0zHH-H8MYb9wmZH6rJ54j2kItzVtgU8jHLKhZIMERgxeHW7lwqZbKTLHCVZFY2b8dQa_ukPgYZnpCetgHDg-GisL9DitMsfEO4HQ0LBcuOh0dL7h2HrdSl2eYcfZS9BtPRkm5-mjmJ3c5zkGDOVYYKPU9G7j3N6eZYW4Tdy)

Fellow American,

The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them.

**Faith.** Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people.

**Family.** Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way.

**Freedom.** It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress.

[**This is a simple truth:**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=405abf69febd4c98b288f47f8652fc49&_e=EVo-iVcOG2y5dyaMcSJgxMSyaKlPJ3isQpYTwuI-CM8VLmX0ZeWys0lwYu9VBS2sJrekaD26rVfyiZtLBxmN7EULktu0FtWnA8mzQjYUqLJsMNI-jwJhCX_vgA4ug9YPucEv-zRBFEKt0eaCPzw6tGHSlXbNVg3m9DZLSG98h_pIkP35x-BHVH7ZIFOzALeGp3TjwGe17Ngh-L28RVSQWteNp0zHH-H8MYb9wmZH6rLl8UKPtfoSj6vP0l3nIUGqRJ6UFaO7yaIuEV_b-q-_0bgHDvzaaILVA-tbDzumSyPXDhXk4ydYLrZaqej4FEYV-EiCdGhA9u9k2u9juTwx5IG61MCPx0hwjf3mjnxidMM0sCQKHOB4hH76BgHipapm) America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are!

[** SUPPORT MIKE JOHNSON > **](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=405abf69febd4c98b288f47f8652fc49&_e=EVo-iVcOG2y5dyaMcSJgxMSyaKlPJ3isQpYTwuI-CM8VLmX0ZeWys0lwYu9VBS2sJrekaD26rVfyiZtLBxmN7EULktu0FtWnA8mzQjYUqLJsMNI-jwJhCX_vgA4ug9YPucEv-zRBFEKt0eaCPzw6tGHSlXbNVg3m9DZLSG98h_pIkP35x-BHVH7ZIFOzALeGp3TjwGe17Ngh-L28RVSQWteNp0zHH-H8MYb9wmZH6rKeDSJy_d3kEyO18BV1wu-BWctHPEkmvQLOqcE3o50Lrljf2Pl_sWhTNdsvw2e5rZBiWWnZyu3jxNDILTlwiGZ8FQc5Z5EnhCFJ_TDApWQ9rqg_aBNAuMVVT01Rq8O31waqrPtVEjsmgoqs5yW-VJ6C)

Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives.

**This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness.**

We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here.

[**Today, to continue to help lead this critical fight, I need your financial support - to restore our country and defend our values. Can you make a donation immediately?**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=405abf69febd4c98b288f47f8652fc49&_e=EVo-iVcOG2y5dyaMcSJgxMSyaKlPJ3isQpYTwuI-CM8VLmX0ZeWys0lwYu9VBS2sJrekaD26rVfyiZtLBxmN7EULktu0FtWnA8mzQjYUqLJsMNI-jwJhCX_vgA4ug9YPucEv-zRBFEKt0eaCPzw6tGHSlXbNVg3m9DZLSG98h_pIkP35x-BHVH7ZIFOzALeGp3TjwGe17Ngh-L28RVSQWteNp0zHH-H8MYb9wmZH6rKSGDvxnOpc1LbKrqKchuG3uDup-EgEQeRHQpOv9aQQLbz992l3hM2tBboE0U7ucGsYrKtIMP4Q9WVs2QYQiFfLslutFVLlnzFOcO74oL62WdAb1jD1AVA7d-MnydVSKTWEwY_x1hJfdco8l_kKR3Ww)

I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. [**We simply must make a change before it 's too late.**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=405abf69febd4c98b288f47f8652fc49&_e=EVo-iVcOG2y5dyaMcSJgxMSyaKlPJ3isQpYTwuI-CM8VLmX0ZeWys0lwYu9VBS2sJrekaD26rVfyiZtLBxmN7EULktu0FtWnA8mzQjYUqLJsMNI-jwJhCX_vgA4ug9YPucEv-zRBFEKt0eaCPzw6tGHSlXbNVg3m9DZLSG98h_pIkP35x-BHVH7ZIFOzALeGp3TjwGe17Ngh-L28RVSQWteNp0zHH-H8MYb9wmZH6rIXtvXbTFXMy-3bZVoT8iBJZQWQ3McKtyccpNGPf9XuN_hvwASnldrnoG2XsOMofC_6kjogyTC62mYgWMQXfbeU7OLX-x8xE_U63LN1XDE6XXvUecvIFKzv_6uyJ5B1Sjzg5kTq7oLvRO-7yBT0K-au)

clean_body: I believe to my core that the most important things in life are God, family, and pride in our country. These are the values that guide me and shape my life. | Fellow American, The most important things in life are faith, family, and freedom. That's not just a slogan, these happen to be the foundations of our great country. That is why I am fighting every day to preserve them. Faith. Our nation began with the bold declaration that all men are created equal by God, and that our rights derive from Him and not the government. The founders insisted that faith must remain central to our national identity because, as George Washington summarized, "religion and morality are indispensable supports" of our republic. Like so many American households through the generations, in our house we instill faith in the hearts of our children, serve God, and serve people. Family. Stable, happy families are the basis of any thriving society, and public policy should always acknowledge this obvious truth. Strengthening the nuclear family should be a top priority, and government should get out of the way and respect parental rights. Kelly and I have been very intentional about passing along the values of hard work, honor, and sacrifice to our children, just as our parents passed them along to us. For nearly two and a half centuries, this has been the American way. Freedom. It is a self-evident truth that God endows all of us with inherent freedoms, such as the natural and unalienable rights to life, liberty, conscience, and the ability to pursue happiness, own property, build wealth and defend ourselves and our families. The purpose of government is to secure these rights, and the ideas we advance should always aim to maintain and increase the liberty of the American people. I've devoted my life and career to fighting for those fundamental freedoms and traditional values, first in the courts as a constitutional law attorney, and now in the Congress. America is the freest, most powerful, most successful nation in the history of world - but we cannot maintain that status if we are led by politicians who hate the very foundations that made us who we are! Right now in America, children are being taught in many schools to be ashamed of their country and themselves. The pledge is being taken out of school because it mentions God. Free speech is being censored and silenced right before our eyes. Democrats are fighting for the right to elective abortion right up to the moment of birth. Unelected, unaccountable bureaucrats are seeking control of almost every aspect of our lives. This is simply un-American, and we must stop the madness. We must elect more leaders who make decisions based on American values with an emphasis on God, family, and country. It's the only way to preserve the blessings we have been given here. Fellow American, we have a chance to save our country from the radical Left that is aiming to destroy it, but we're running out of time. I'm not sure what version of America we will leave to our kids if we continue down this path. I made a promise when I was first elected to do what is best for our country, and for Louisiana, and I intend to keep that promise. It's why I have been a trusted ally of President Donald Trump, who selected me for critical positions and endorsed all of my campaigns. It's also why I was elected by my colleagues to serve as Vice Chairman of the House Republican Conference - one of seven elected leadership positions for Republicans in the House - and to chair the Subcommittee on the Constitution and Civil Liberties in the prestigious Judiciary Committee. We are working in Congress every day to defend our conservative way of life and lead the fight for freedom, The path we're on currently will lead us to destruction. But that outcome is not inevitable. We still have the ability to turn this country around-- IF conscientious conservatives across America will stand up RIGHT NOW. Suzanne Crouch shines a light on the personal tragedies that made her a fierce advocate of those struggling with mental illness and addiction.

** In The News: Crouch 'reimagines' government, taxes (https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=dd71ce714c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
As your Governor, I plan to reimagine government, ensuring it works for you. By streamlining agencies and connecting services, we'll create a government that's more accessible and responsive to your needs.

Thank you to Brian Howey for sitting down with me to discuss how I plan to lead Indiana forward.
https://stateaffairs.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/HPI231026ds-1.pdf?utm_source=email&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=weekly-edition-pdf&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=dd71ce714c-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Article Preview:
------------------------------------------------------------

Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch has unveiled the gold standard of slogans for the evolving 2024 campaign with her “Axe the Tax” plan that would phase out Indiana’s personal income tax.

It has become the crux of her campaign. It is succinct, memorable and stands out. In contrast, U.S. Sen. Mike Braun is using “Outsider, Conservative, Businessman”; Brad Chambers has adopted “Conservative Outsider”; Eric Doden has “Real Results”; and Curtis Hill says he will provide “Conservative Leadership for Indiana.” Democrat Jennifer McCormick, meanwhile, is saying, “It’s Time to Put Hoosiers First.”

Campaign tax plans can make or break a candidacy. Crouch’s Axe the Tax plan has been receiving both accolades and incoming.

Crouch’s response to such critics is that they are missing her central point. “We’re not going to do it overnight,” she said in an exclusive Howey Politics Indiana interview Friday at Shapiro’s Deli in Indianapolis. “We can’t,” she said. “It’s going to be phased in. It will be in place with triggers in case there’s an economic downturn.”
She points to Indiana’s historic budget surpluses, which swelled to a record $6 billion in 2022. That prompted some observers to say that it is a “failure of imagination,” or as Michael Leppert wrote in a July 2022 Capital Chronicle column, a “$6.1 billion surplus shows an absence of ideas.”

Crouch told HPI: “If we limit how much we allow government to grow, and then we take excess revenue of the future and instead of putting it in government and spent by government, which is what we’ve always done, we take that and put it toward eliminating the income tax.”

Crouch is attempting to become Indiana’s first female governor. When we met at Shapiro’s on Friday ... as I extended my hand for a shake, she opted for a hug instead. She is sunny, cheerful and engaging. Beyond her “Axe the Tax” plan, she is calling for a “reimagining” of government.

“People aren’t calling government because they’re having a good day,” she said. “They’re calling government because they have an issue or a problem and could use the help. And often, they don’t even know where to call. How would you? We need to reimagine government and services.”

clean_body: Suzanne Crouch shines a light on the personal tragedies that made her a fierce advocate of those struggling with mental illness and addiction. In The News: Crouch 'reimagines' government, taxes () As your Governor, I plan to reimagine government, ensuring it works for you. By streamlining agencies and connecting services, we'll create a government that's more accessible and responsive to your needs. Thank you to Brian Howey for sitting down with me to discuss how I plan to lead Indiana forward. Article Preview: Lt. Gov. Suzanne Crouch has unveiled the gold standard of slogans for the evolving 2024 campaign with her “Axe the Tax” plan that would phase out Indiana’s personal income tax. It has become the crux of her campaign. It is succinct, memorable and stands out. In contrast, U.S. Sen. Mike Braun is using “Outsider, Conservative, Businessman”; Brad Chambers has adopted “Conservative Outsider”; Eric Doden has “Real Results”; and Curtis Hill says he will provide “Conservative Leadership for Indiana.” Democrat Jennifer McCormick, meanwhile, is saying, “It’s Time to Put Hoosiers First.” Campaign tax plans can make or break a candidacy. Crouch’s Axe the Tax plan has been receiving both accolades and incoming. Crouch’s response to such critics is that they are missing her central point. “We’re not going to do it overnight,” she said in an exclusive Howey Politics Indiana interview Friday at Shapiro’s Deli in Indianapolis. “We can’t,” she said. “It’s going to be phased in. It will be in place with triggers in case there’s an economic downturn.” She points to Indiana’s historic budget surpluses, which swelled to a record $6 billion in 2022. That prompted some observers to say that it is a “failure of imagination,” or as Michael Leppert wrote in a July 2022 Capital Chronicle column, a “$6.1 billion surplus shows an absence of ideas.” Crouch told HPI: “If we limit how much we allow government to grow, and then we take excess revenue of the future and instead of putting it in government and spent by government, which is what we’ve always done, we take that and put it toward eliminating the income tax.” Crouch is attempting to become Indiana’s first female governor. When we met at Shapiro’s on Friday ... as I extended my hand for a shake, she opted for a hug instead. She is sunny, cheerful and engaging. Beyond her “Axe the Tax” plan, she is calling for a “reimagining” of government. “People aren’t calling government because they’re having a good day,” she said. “They’re calling government because they have an issue or a problem and could use the help. And often, they don’t even know where to call. How would you? We need to reimagine government and services.” Read the Full Article () Let's keep the conversation going! name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: Another tragedy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
Our lawmakers must act.
| | |
---
Friend —
By now, I’m sure you have seen the tragedy unfolding in Lewiston, Maine. On Wednesday night, a gunman armed with an assault weapon shot and killed 18 people and injured 13 others at multiple locations in town before fleeing. Law enforcement has yet to catch him.
Wednesday night, Mainers went to bed with heavy hearts over this significant loss, and yesterday morning they woke up to a community in lockdown for fear of more casualties. **Only in America are mass shootings the norm.**
When the gunfire started, the local children’s bowling league was in progress. Witnesses, including children, have recounted being grazed by bullets and hiding in bowling pin machinery. It is our greatest moral failing as a country that we continue to let these types of deadly weapons into our community spaces, when we have seen nothing but tragedy and trauma as a result.
I know what it means to lose a loved one to gun violence — I lost my father to gun violence. My heart aches for the people of Lewiston who are now faced with that same pain.
**This is the 565th mass shooting in America this year.** We cannot continue to allow lawmakers to look the other way as more and more of our people die.
I have dedicated my life to serving my community, and as an advocate and a Congresswoman, I fought to pass gun safety legislation. In the House, I was the chair of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force. Today I am as resolute as ever in that mission, and when I am elected to the U.S. Senate, I will make it my No. 1 priority to reel in the gun lobby and fight for a future where Americans don’t have to fear for their lives just by going out to dinner or to their local bowling alley. No más.
Debbie Mucarsel-Powell

https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

President Biden has just announced that he approved $9 billion [https://www.cnbc.com/2023/10/04/biden-cancels-9-billion-in-student-debt-for-125000-borrowers-.html] in student loan forgiveness for 125,000 Americans, primarily for borrowers working in the federal government, those in income-driven repayment plans, and those with disabilities.

This is a critical step forward, but we need to go further. Federal student loan debt exceeds $1.6 trillion [https://educationdata.org/student-loan-debt-statistics] , making home ownership, family planning, and retirement out of reach for too many Americans. Experts are predicting that consumer spending will fall by about $14 billion now that student loan payments have resumed.

Furthermore, SAVE, President Biden’s income-driven repayment plan, has encountered issues since launching in August. Although the plan promised to save borrowers at least $1,000 a year, the Education Department estimated that 420,000 borrowers have faced payment errors due to program calculation problems, [https://www.businessinsider.com/why-is-save-student-loan-payment-so-high-single-mom-2023-10] with some borrowers being billed nearly $300 more a month than what they were originally told.

Democrats cannot afford to stand by and watch this economic disaster unfold. We need to listen to young people and make education affordable and accessible for all. I’ve put forward a plan designed to do just that [https://themessenger.com/opinion/democrats-cant-be-complacent-student-debt-college-loans-interest-affordability] , by extending the moratorium on student debt payments, forgiving student debt up to $50,000, stopping interest on student debt from accruing, and expanding debt relief programs.

Tell President Biden: Adopt the Khanna Plan and cancel student loan debt up to $50,000. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/khanna-plan-student-debt-petition?contactdata=WAhnzAMvb5pTwmTkHYSqWyLJO0SjiCDZ4HcsM+BTNNY/4nRxLgmuAMYsMUK5CqQ9QMwovHL39QnxXFNyLbQGfsArq9tvEJPkPUdx8vKQClYPGXda3q0qaak4NMUWNP9EmfCalgRr2ayjc/np/NVsVg==]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FOthMaszpo&t=2 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FOthMaszpo&t=2]

President Biden does not need Congressional authority to move on this. The White House can cancel student loan debt up to $50,000 using authority granted to the president by the Higher Education Act.

Relieving student debt will undeniably benefit our economy, thereby benefiting all of us. With their spending power improved, younger Americans will have the opportunity to invest in their futures while also channeling money into their local economies.

Sign if you agree: President Biden must deliver on student debt relief. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/khanna-plan-student-debt-petition?contactdata=WAhnzAMvb5pTwmTkHYSqWyLJO0SjiCDZ4HcsM+BTNNY/4nRxLgmuAMYsMUK5CqQ9QMwovHL39QnxXFNyLbQGfsArq9tvEJPkPUdx8vKQClYPGXda3q0qaak4NMUWNP9EmfCalgRr2ayjc/np/NVsVg==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/khanna-plan-student-debt-petition?contactdata=WAhnzAMvb5pTwmTkHYSqWyLJO0SjiCDZ4HcsM+BTNNY/4nRxLgmuAMYsMUK5CqQ9QMwovHL39QnxXFNyLbQGfsArq9tvEJPkPUdx8vKQClYPGXda3q0qaak4NMUWNP9EmfCalgRr2ayjc/np/NVsVg==]

In solidarity,
Ro

name: Katie Porter
subject: Insurance company BS surrounding COVID vaccines
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Getting a COVID vaccine should be like getting a flu shot.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=32147%2E3422442%2EXuXflP)
Derek, when I went to book COVID booster appointments for my three kids, I was disappointed to find the earliest appointments were a month out, and I couldn’t find consecutive appointments for our family.
Getting a COVID vaccine should be like getting a flu shot. Simple, convenient, and accessible. But some insurance companies are delaying or denying vaccine coverage, which is preventing Americans from getting protected.
This vaccine roll-out is the first in which the federal government has not been responsible for purchasing and distributing COVID-19 shots. **With insurance companies now a critical piece of the puzzle, their administrative red tape has made it difficult for folks to find “in-network” coverage.**
This is BS. Insurance companies had ample time to prepare for this expected demand for vaccines.**I wrote a letter to the executives at insurance companies like Kaiser and Blue Cross Blue Shield, asking them to address the red tape and prohibitive costs that Americans have experienced while trying to get vaccinated.**
I’m waiting on their response, and I’ll continue doing everything I can to hold Big Insurance companies accountable. Can you add your name in support of my letter?
[Add your name ›››](https://act.katieporter.com/signup/kp4s-em-covid-vaccine/?source=EMAM27_1_FLU_20231027_V1_F&akid=32147%2E3422442%2EXuXflP)
_And don’t forget to look for a COVID vaccine appointment sooner rather than later._
Thanks for reading,
Katie Porter

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner. Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963. Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook. Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company. Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce. He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. In addition to early weekday voting, many counties, including Allen, Hamilton, Lake, Marion, and Vanderburgh, have polling locations open tomorrow and Saturday, November 4th. # [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=989%2E552475%2E13oTFH)
Hi Peter, it's Bob Casey's Finance Team with an update for you before our end-of-month deadline.
We set a $50,000 fundraising goal for a big reason, so we'll explain — but if you're ready to chip in right away you can use this link:

Our campaign and our opponent David McCormick's campaign have to pay for a lot of the same expenses. We have to hire staff, run advertisements, knock on doors, and reach voters from Erie to Allentown and everywhere in between.
The difference is that when David McCormick needs more campaign funds, he can just write himself a big check. _Remember, he spent $14 million of his personal fortune on his 2022 campaign._
**When we need help, we rely on supporters like you.**
Whether you chip in $100 or just $10 to this email, every dollar powers our work to make sure we have a real Pennsylvanian fighting for us in the U.S. Senate, not a mega-millionaire from Connecticut.
