# Capitol Report
October 27, 2023
---
|
---
| **U.S. Supreme Court keeps controversial gun law blocked**
The U.S. Supreme Court on Oct. 20 rejected a request to reinstate a Missouri law that purports to declare many federal gun laws unenforceable in the state. A federal district judge had ruled the law violates the U.S. Constitution’s Supremacy Clause, which holds that federal laws trump contrary state laws.

Missouri Attorney General Andrew Bailey, a Republican, had asked the high court to allow the law to remain in effect while the 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals considers his appeal of the district judge’s ruling. The Supreme Court rejected Bailey’s request in a brief order with only arch-conservative Justice Clarence Thomas noting a dissent, which he did not explain.

The Republican-led General Assembly enacted the law in 2021 over Democratic objections. In addition to purporting to nullify federal gun laws, the measure also authorizes those arrested or convicted of a federal gun crime to sue local police departments for civil fines of $50,000 per occurrence for assisting federal agents in their cases and prohibits local governments from hiring – in any capacity – former federal officers who previously enforced gun laws.

Ruling in a legal challenge brought by the U.S. Department of Justice, U.S. District Judge Brian Wimes of the Western District of Missouri said the state law clearly interferes with federal officials’ ability to enforce federal firearms regulations, in violation of the Supremacy Clause, and is “invalid, null, void, and of no effect.”

The Supreme Court’s refusal to weigh in means Missouri’s law will remain unenforceable while litigation in the case continues. The case is _United States v. State of Missouri_.
---
|
---
| **Records show House speaker double-dipped on travel costs**
Republican House Speaker Dean Plocher sought and received taxpayer reimbursement for about $4,509 in travel expenses that his campaign committee also paid for, the Missouri Independent reported on Oct. 23. The potentially illegal double-dipping took place on at least nine different occasions over five years, according to the online news site.

The Independent discovered the double-dipping by comparing the expense reports of Plocher’s official House office, which it obtained through an open records request, against the contribution and expenditure reports his campaign committee, Plocher for Missouri. Those reports are filed with the Missouri Ethics Commission and posted online.

Citing legal experts, the Independent reported the submitting of false reports could be prosecuted as stealing from the state, a Class A misdemeanor, or as Class B misdemeanor of making a false declaration. Plocher’s actions also could be considered as converting campaign funds for personal use, which is prohibited by state law and punishable by a civil fine.

Although state law allows elected officials to use campaign funds for official expenses, they cannot also seek reimbursement of those costs from taxpayers. In Plocher’s case, his campaign paid for his travel – including a trip to Hawaii this summer to attend a conference – while the House personally reimbursed him for those same costs. In every instance he sought taxpayer reimbursement, Plocher signed a document swearing the payments he sought to recover were made with “personal funds, for which I have not been reimbursed,” the Independent reported.

After the Independent filed its request for Plocher’s office expense reports – but days before the Independent published its story – Plocher began repaying House for the questioned reimbursements. In a statement to the Independent, Plocher said he is “in the process of completing a full review of all expenditures and will correct any additional administrative errors in the spirit of full transparency.”

Five years ago today, an antisemitic hater slaughtered 11 innocent people at the Tree of Life Synagogue in Pittsburgh.

Today, an armed and dangerous gunman remains on the loose in Maine, authorities think, after killing 18 and wounding more than a dozen more. But he could be anywhere.

There have been dozens of mass shootings in the United States this year. Hundreds, maybe thousands, of people’s lives will never be the same.

One whose political life has changed is Rep. Jared Golden of Maine, who said that the massacre in Maine reflected “a false confidence that our community was above this, and that we could be in full control, among many other misjudgments... The time has now come for me to take responsibility for this failure,” he said, announcing that he will now support a return to the assault weapons ban that lapsed nearly two decades ago.

**As a combat veteran, I know what assault weapons can do, and I know that they have no place among the civilian population.**

**The assault weapons ban made us safer, and I will vote to reinstate it. I will also vote for universal background checks, red flag laws, outlawing ghost guns, and improved mental health services. Help put me in Congress so that I can do what Scott Perry won’t to protect our people and communities.**

When will Scott Perry realize that our communities in central Pennsylvania are not above this? Never. How many of our neighbors will have to die needlessly? One is too many.

**The loss of life due to gun violence in Harrisburg, York County, and other localities in Central PA is growing and unacceptable. The city of Harrisburg logged 23 homicides last year, the highest number of annual killings in at least 36 years. 2023 has been the worst year for murder-suicides in York County history. 28 homicides occurred in York County in 2022, one of the highest numbers ever.**

_T-shirts for victims of gun violence outside Hadee Mosque in Harrisburg, Oct. 15, 2023_
We need to be clear-eyed about this issue. [Read my comprehensive approach to reducing gun violence and improving gun safety here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72315379/434928148/-663341527?id=13&source=RC_EM_EN_WL_231027_1_1&refcode2=0d33ba4c-fb74-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&contactdata=T+H0tWc+AOxnx+mXKd9XrPduYrABB02vGE0LnHPzYLry/ce1a0r3VuTEzDhzFCjE&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85ODExOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDMzYmE0Yy1mYjc0LWVlMTEtYjAwNC0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yr1uxE_lXKb26mI8iSi50EoLeAus9t8TizIzhv3qbMI=&emci=9797a367-ef74-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=0d33ba4c-fb74-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=24669367)

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/72318949/434934581/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiN2M2ZjZiNTgtZmY3NC1lZTExLWIwMDQtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=nMwOwufPetxiqW6kKvPGnXsHytcgzmcW49PDenv2-N0=&emci=8044cc51-ff74-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&emdi=7c6f6b58-ff74-ee11-b004-00224832eb73&ceid=14016711)

Donald Trump was a prolific poster on Twitter/X, driving entire news cycles and causing national and global uproar over his posts.
But even after he was suspended from X, he never stopped posting. He just found a _different_ site — one created _specifically_ for him.
That’s where Truth Social comes in. Unsurprisingly, Trump posts on it every single day.
**For 50 days, we read Trump’s Truth Social posts so you didn’t have to. Here’s a sampling of what we found:**

Peter –
This week, Republicans united to elect Representative Mike Johnson from Louisiana as Speaker of the House. Speaker Johnson is a friend and true conservative. While most speak in sound bites, he speaks with a true understanding of conservative philosophy. Mike Johnson will make an outstanding Speaker.
I also held a press conference this week to make a simple demand: No additional aid for Ukraine without also securing our southern border. This is a commonsense position, and you can watch my full remarks below.
Thank you for your continued support. If you would like to make a donation of any amount to my campaign, I would greatly appreciate your contribution [at this link.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001WtbHUqButtHUYpPp0C_J2Luy9hvi-hPBjuCeWuX4mi6CWLSOdtL9rFWvTvRXM9TC0BvRkySGFp3Tyku_TCdQjLpwHOniBBzrkA7_Voi3GgUKqPMXiDF-aUtGxTFalk5DmpWP48ibgb8fg8MAeM0MPmEQsoyfZvq6XpITWyyKzfI49rxtMSVdO7zgIxXLSWsf9nIx47YRnn9TMv38c3X5BJziPFPMF-Og6d9ftEZA-w9h6p6ZK7zCF7BpBy9t84N2ZeBOZqbFGxrcxkIIF2bpyLJ0_v0QDzPsB0mTBT-lgYC8DAYUnmzMYXZV-jNMMP0NqZN2n6_fOBP1MelkwkF1eoramI6Ur0Un&c=uMFDM6MHUxqJHTGPhbukbKRKLG8WSB55ED_u79Ch1W2bcixROjUaEA==&ch=79t9_Rs_jnVhVMSNhiZy2FSdlbSQaTkkeDskdCV3Znp-o-D12nZuag==)

| OUR SOUTHERN BORDER MUST COME FIRST

| Republicans in Congress must stand by a simple line in the sand: no Ukraine aid without also securing our border with meaningful policy reforms.
This week I led a press conference that outlined my plan to do just that. If we beat Russia and secure our border, America wins. We must do both. Both are in our interest.
Republicans must understand that this is the only way we will get meaningful border security. This is our one chance. There is no other legislative vehicle other than Ukraine aid that Biden wants badly enough. So we must negotiate border security into it.
We can do this. Biden already proposed $14 billion for the border in the supplemental spending package he submitted to Congress. But we know that's not enough. We know you need policy reform along with the funding.
If we let Russia win, our deterrence is screwed for the next 50 years. Expect dictators like Putin to keep starting wars and watch American influence diminish while China's increases.
But we can't keep fighting that battle while Texas is invaded. We must do both. This must be the grand bargain.

| Iran continues to test the United States, taking advantage of the war in Israel to probe our weaknesses and see what our response will be. Iranian proxies are now responsible for attacking American troops resulting in serious injuries in recent days.
We must make it clear: If you attack American forces, you should pay the price. Swift and aggressive action deters further attacks. Sometimes that simple fact needs to be spelled out.
You don't need to bomb Tehran to retaliate.
I know too many people illogically believe there's only two options: do nothing or do everything. There's a lot of options in the middle to deter aggression from Iran and prevent this war from spreading. We must take them.

subject: Tell Senate Democratic Leadership: Rein in the Supreme Court
body:
Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA:
PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS
The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur.

Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again.

GOAL: 5,000 actions
TAKE ACTION https://links.messages.lcv. ? ?
? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents.

This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health.

Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces.

Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/yAyZM-

We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks.

But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers.

Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters.

Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. https://links.messages.lcv.

Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters.

Sincerely,

Madeleine Foote
Deputy Legislative Director

clean_body: Help us reach 5,000 comments to overcome corporate polluters.? Tell the EPA: PROTECT COMMUNITIES FROM CHEMICAL DISASTERS The EPA is now seeking public input on a new rule to require industrial facilities to disclose the hazardous chemical risks posed by their operations, take stronger actions to prevent accidents, and move quickly should an accident occur. Corporate polluters have already killed this rule once, when Trump decided to allow these dangerous facilities to operate in secrecy. We cannot allow them to succeed again. GOAL: 5,000 actions TAKE ACTION ? ? ? Peter ? a critical new rule from Biden's EPA would finally require dangerous industrial facilities to disclose any hazardous chemicals they contain ? and take steps to prevent and mitigate harmful accidents. This rule will especially protect people living closest to these facilities, which are overwhelmingly low-wealth communities and communities of color, as well as workers. Decades of environmental racism ensured these hazardous facilities were located in the neighborhoods with the least resources to fight back, meaning these frontline communities are disproportionately exposed to chemical accidents and harmful pollutants that have jeopardized their health. Here's the problem: powerful interests, like the oil and gas industry and the chemical industry, are demanding the EPA once again abandon these important protections. Unless our movement speaks up right now, we may miss out on this opportunity to advance environmental justice and worker safety, and create healthier communities and workplaces. Please TAKE ACTION right now to protect communities from chemical hazards. To beat the chemical industry, we need to urgently deliver 5,000 comments supporting the EPA's proposed rule. We've already seen the dangers these facilities can pose. In 2013, an explosion of ammonium nitrate fertilizer killed 15 people and destroyed a school, nursing home, and many homes in the city of West, Texas. The Obama administration began a painstaking process to prevent similar disasters, culminating in enhanced protections for minimizing and managing chemical risks. But after an aggressive campaign from the chemical industry and other corporate polluters, the Trump administration abandoned the rule, choosing to prioritize corporate profits over the health of vulnerable communities and workers. Under President Biden, the EPA can now reverse this dangerous decision and finally help protect people, especially environmental justice communities, from hazardous pollution and chemical disasters. Don't let corporate polluters undermine critical environment protections. TAKE ACTION now to help us deliver 5,000 comments supporting environmental justice and corporate accountability. Thank you for taking action to protect people and workers from environmental disasters. Sincerely, Madeleine Foote Deputy Legislative Director League of Conservation Voters ? ? ? ? ? subject: The odds are stacked against us.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend – when Colin ran for Congress in 2018, the odds were stacked against him.
His opponent was a Republican Congressman who had held his seat for 11 terms. Colin and our team put everything we had into the campaign – but just 48 days from the election, the polls gave Colin a 10% chance of winning, and the district was leaning Republican.
In the last days of the campaign, Colin worked day and night to connect with Texans and earn their votes. He slowly chipped away at his opponent's lead as voters got to know him.
By Election Day, he had a 37% chance of victory. And when the numbers finally came in, he won with 52% of the vote.
[Split a donation between Serve America and Colin Allred to defeat Ted Cruz →] [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Friend, this time around we're facing an even bigger opponent: Ted Cruz. But we're starting this race with much better odds. Polls show Colin just 5 points down with 14% of voters undecided.
What's more, Ted Cruz only won reelection by 2.6% last time.
We have a clear path to victory, and all it's going to take is connecting with enough undecided voters. That's why Colin is on the road traveling to every corner of Texas, shaking every hand he can and listening to what voters have to say.
But voter outreach on this massive scale is expensive. That's why Colin's counting on grassroots supporters like you to help him do it, so please: Can you split a donation of $25 between Colin and Serve America before our midnight fundraising deadline to help us reach the undecided voters we need to fire Ted Cruz? → [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]

Earlier this year, in a transparent attempt to override voters who support reproductive freedom, they attempted to change state rules to require 60% approval on any ballot measure for it to pass — as opposed to the normal 50% majority. But after months of organizing, Ohioans turned out against this subversion of democracy and voted against it 57-43. Now, we need to ensure that we get voters to the polls to hit that 50% threshold and codify abortion rights in Ohio once and for all. **Virginia stands as the only state in the South that has not restricted abortion access since the overturning of**** _Roe v. Wade,_****making it a safe place for pregnant people in the region to receive necessary medical care.** But Republicans in the State House have introduced a bill that would make it a felony for doctors to perform abortions after a number of weeks, with support from GOP Governor Glenn Youngkin, who aims for Virginia to be the blueprint for how to pass abortion bans in states around the country. The only thing keeping Virginia from passing an abortion ban is a small Democratic majority in the State Senate. In 11 days, every seat in the Virginia state legislature is up for election, and with new districts, we have a crucial opportunity to expand our majority in the State Senate and take back the State House. That’s why Republicans have launched a $1.4 million ad buy to attack reproductive justice and turn out anti-abortion voters.1 But organized people are the best defense against organized money, and together, we can elect representatives who will protect the freedom to receive abortion care. In over a dozen other states, the Working Families Party is turning out voters for candidates in next month’s elections who will fight for the right to receive an abortion. **And early voting is already underway in several states, including Ohio and Virginia.** [**If you’re with us, help us reach as many voters as possible from now through Election Day. clean_body: The battle for abortion freedom is being fought on multiple fronts this year — including two states with races that could have a huge impact: Ohio and Virginia. | | | Peter, Since the overturning of Roe v. Wade, we’ve seen Republicans ban access to life-saving abortion care every chance they get. But on Election Day this November 7th, we have some major opportunities to defend abortion freedom. We’re fighting like hell to protect and expand the freedom to receive abortion care in states like Ohio and Virginia, and to elect working class champions across the country who will stand up for abortion rights. The battle for abortion freedom is being fought on multiple fronts this year — including two states with races that could have a huge impact: Ohio and Virginia. In Ohio, voters are deciding on a ballot measure that would codify abortion access into the state constitution, protecting it from future attacks. But Republicans have been playing dirty. Earlier this year, in a transparent attempt to override voters who support reproductive freedom, they attempted to change state rules to require 60% approval on any ballot measure for it to pass — as opposed to the normal 50% majority. But after months of organizing, Ohioans turned out against this subversion of democracy and voted against it 57-43. Now, we need to ensure that we get voters to the polls to hit that 50% threshold and codify abortion rights in Ohio once and for all. Virginia stands as the only state in the South that has not restricted abortion access since the overturning of Roe v. Wade,making it a safe place for pregnant people in the region to receive necessary medical care. But Republicans in the State House have introduced a bill that would make it a felony for doctors to perform abortions after a number of weeks, with support from GOP Governor Glenn Youngkin, who aims for Virginia to be the blueprint for how to pass abortion bans in states around the country. The only thing keeping Virginia from passing an abortion ban is a small Democratic majority in the State Senate. In 11 days, every seat in the Virginia state legislature is up for election, and with new districts, we have a crucial opportunity to expand our majority in the State Senate and take back the State House. That’s why Republicans have launched a $1.4 million ad buy to attack reproductive justice and turn out anti-abortion voters.1 But organized people are the best defense against organized money, and together, we can elect representatives who will protect the freedom to receive abortion care. In over a dozen other states, the Working Families Party is turning out voters for candidates in next month’s elections who will fight for the right to receive an abortion. And early voting is already underway in several states, including Ohio and Virginia. In solidarity, Working Families Party Source: 1\. , Politico, Oct. 15, 2023. Thoughts? Feedback? | **MEET JIM**

Gov. Jim Justice is a conservative leader, successful businessman, high school basketball coach, and devoted family man. Before being elected, Gov. Justice led over 100 companies, creating thousands of jobs.

Gov. Justice has delivered on his promise of diversifying West Virginia's economy. He enacted the largest personal income tax cut in state history. He protects traditional values and has been recognized as a pro-life champion, signing more pro-life legislation into law than any governor in state history. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. body:
The Lewiston community will be forever altered by gun violence
#

In an interview with FOX News, new Speaker of the House Mike Johnson said this in regards to the recent shootings in Lewiston, Maine:
**_“The problem is the human heart. It’s not guns, it’s not the weapons.”**_
Mike Johnson, we ask you these two questions:
Did the human heart kill eight people at a restaurant, and seven others at a bowling alley, within a matter of minutes?
Did the human heart injure dozens of other people at two separate locations, all in one night?
It’s the guns.
MAGA extremists will blame gun violence on anything but the problem itself: unfettered access to guns.
Why? Because protecting the gun lobby is their main priority.
We live in a country where extreme politicians would rather stand with the gun lobby than pass legislation that would save their constituents’ lives from gun violence.
Until our leaders listen to the vast majority of Americans to take meaningful, commonsense action on gun safety, more and more communities nationwide will join Lewiston and the countless other towns who have been ripped apart by the scourge of gun violence.
We know times like these are tremendously difficult, but now is the time we must turn our anger, frustration, and sadness into meaningful action. We cannot rest until our elected officials stand up and do what is right to end America’s gun violence epidemic.

name: Friends of the Earth
subject: Your Signature is Needed: Plastic is destroying our oceans, harming people, and killing sea turtles
body:
| | | | | [](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080613?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---|---|---

| | **Our precious oceans are being decimated by rampant plastic waste. [_TAKE ACTION NOW: Sign the petition to demand an END to plastic pollution! >>_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080614?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)** It’s no secret that oceans play an integral role in our planet’s ecosystem -- absorbing **massive amounts of carbon dioxide** from the atmosphere, providing us with **HALF of the world’s oxygen,** and storing **90% of additional heat** caused by global warming. And, of course, our oceans serve as an **epicenter of biodiversity,** home to beloved wildlife like coral reefs, sea turtles, whales, and dolphins. **But our oceans are in PERIL, Friend.** Every minute, **an entire garbage truck** of plastics is washed into the ocean -- _**KILLING OVER A MILLION MARINE ANIMALS**_ each year. Scientists predict that at this rate, we’ll have more plastic than fish in the ocean by 2050! [_**Will you stand by and let plastic corporations profit off of the destruction of our oceans? Or will you speak up and demand an END to plastic pollution right now?**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080615?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==) | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080616?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
While you’re reading this email, imagine a baby sea turtle reaching the water for the very first time. _***SPLASH***_ The excited creature swims around and is happy to find something fresh to eat. **Oh no!** The helpless animal tried to swallow plastic thinking that it was a jellyfish! Now, the helpless youngling could _**CHOKE TO DEATH.**_ With the **millions of tons** of plastic in the ocean, it’s no wonder that animals like baby sea turtles are _frequently mistaking plastic for food._
The dangers of plastics don’t stop with our oceans, Friend. Tiny microplastics are _** contaminating our food, water, and air supply**_ at this very moment. Plastic production itself burns through**dirty fossil fuels** that worsen the climate crisis, and these industrial-size factories emit **harmful pollutants** that pose **serious health risks** to nearby residents who are most often low-wealth people of color.
Meanwhile, the federal government has __**FAILED**__ to stand up to Big Plastic and Big Oil, allowing these powerful corporations to profit off their reckless environmental destruction. **If we don’t take steps at the federal level NOW, it will soon be too late to __STOP THE PLASTIC APOCALYPSE.__**
[_**Friend, we aren’t exaggerating when we say that the future of our oceans and our entire planet is on the line. We’ve set an ambitious goal of getting 2,980 grassroots signatures on our petition: DEMAND federal solutions to the environmental plastic crisis NOW >>**_](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080617?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
[SIGN THE PETITION](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2080618?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
**Thanks for protecting our oceans, people, and the planet from plastic, Friends of the Earth**

Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. Roger serves on the Board of Trustees for the Bush School of Government and Public Service at Texas A&M University, the Texas Christian University Board of Trustees, and the National Football Foundation and College Football Hall of Fame Board of Directors.

Friend,
We have known that the Michigan Senate race would be one of the most competitive and most expensive in the country. And because Elissa rejects all corporate PAC money, we knew that the only way to win this race was to rely on a bunch of people giving whatever they can, when they can over time.
And that’s exactly what we’ve done: 92% of our contributions last quarter were $100 or less, with the primary source of those contributions being emails like this one. And it’s $5, $25, or $100 contributions to our emails and texts that help drive what this campaign is able to accomplish: when we can expand our ground-game, hire more staff, and begin airing TV ads down the line.
**That’s why when we found out that one of our potential Republican opponents received $46,200 from the DeVos family in a single day, we shifted into high-gear.** The DeVos family has contributed over $1.6 million dollars to elect candidates who will carry out their agenda at the national level, and the only way to combat that level of influence in our race was to match them with the power of small, grassroots contributions.
The response has been overwhelming. And just further proves that when a whole bunch of people band together, it really does add up. The big checks of megadonors like the DeVoses don’t hold a candle to the power of lots and lots of people giving a little at a time.
But we’ve already seen that they’re going to throw everything they can at this race, which is why it’s so important we keep up our steady stream of grassroots support. This is why we’re asking: [**Will you help us push back against the influence of the DeVos family in our race by chipping in $3 today?](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-oct23.ttRNnI&refcode=em231027-2-15&t=2&akid=753%2E135344%2E9QxMYR)**

| | I was back home in Knoxville earlier this week to celebrate a brave and heroic life cut too short. 23-year-old U.S. Army Specialist [Jeremy Evans](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4e96d8cfadfe4a0799c2ba3fc076feaa&_e=WMycnl0V52SXHDxrPR3FuMNsV5m-sSdsfz-9NzfeWIsGilSSa-jHSnpWQc0rntSCbLp5LwB9Fxw7SJm-doMawA0ZgwHOV1FwUdmX1XYrZkQENF-RngdwN9ScC3jY6N_NljJf_brn1-zXJO-SnfSETXmqluR9XV9u6hj0Exmfa667rYV7zFulPpdjX9AUiSU1zfYvAbWdFI5UYaDoqBs4L3aKljDQVPdeVBlUl8y5S929e6khnM0aVhwjcj3nrGB60IkQvAPF0A7e8XoxYFhGs6hXZpfKxxmAjW4e6ROHIAeDV0iK_foC_N1LpYA2HqMr91mhp4FH5VsKp4ScHozOEg%3D%3D) was one of two soldiers killed earlier this month when an Army vehicle flipped during a training event in Alaska. In addition to being a selfless military hero, Jeremy was a brother, son, husband, and friend, which was on full display during this event. He was [honored](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=4e96d8cfadfe4a0799c2ba3fc076feaa&_e=WMycnl0V52SXHDxrPR3FuMNsV5m-sSdsfz-9NzfeWItJRfRo0ekfMypbLpDq0Dy_dAXNIoJi6DSP5oHxUdLAjyxTVc40Yir1bIRwBo6pi43_nKiehi8o8hbDo_YxwF63R-mz80V6UTvJBxT9y3YZ5gYVTqSgak7BiO3ykLF4HCqaP6xCzsb74Q5e9v4jolbTo0FlAbHz20uVGv42fLS0pGnIAslS0eyul9QtvnBXWCvKLH_slaXw-4ZyETG3mokMPPCeH90KiErKsJ_xecXd-Bxhcb_cDisH9qCCBPkCLKYdGGsnedlQYcxDIS3QyGyo) with a police motorcade as people from all over Knoxville came in droves to pay their respects and remember this amazing young man. Evan wasn’t drafted; he volunteered for this job because there was something down deep inside of him that wanted to give back to this great nation. We owe Jeremy a debt that can never be paid, and it is with great sadness that I extend my most heartfelt condolences to his entire family. May his memory live on through those who knew him, loved him, and will always remember him.

It's been a busy couple of months here in the Mucarsel-Powell household. But I want to take a moment to step back from it all to tell you a little bit about my wife — and why I know that she's the senator our state deserves.

Debbie has always been a rock for her family and her community. As a young immigrant in America, she worked her way through high school to help her mom pay the bills. After graduating college, she dedicated her life to giving back, a path that led her all the way to Congress. On top of all that, she's a dedicated caretaker for her mother, a devoted mom to our children, and my best friend.
Debbie is the kindest, most generous person I've ever met, and a true public servant. But don't let that fool you: _She's a fierce fighter when it comes to protecting Florida and Floridians._ From expanding health care access at Florida International University to flipping a U.S. House seat blue, she's a fearless leader who does not back down.
**In short, Debbie represents everything that our leaders should be.** Meanwhile, Rick Scott represents everything wrong with Washington — and everything that Debbie has spent her life fighting against.
Rick Scott oversaw the largest Medicare fraud in HISTORY. He wants to raise taxes on working families, ban abortions nationwide, and end Social Security and Medicare. He's pushed some of the most harmful, anti-democratic, and divisive rhetoric I've ever heard. **It's no wonder that Republicans, Independents, and Democrats all don’t like him.**
Floridians know that they deserve a leader who understands the real problems facing families; a leader who will never stop fighting for them; a leader like Debbie.

Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

Peter, our Supreme Court is supposed to be above politics and personal gain.
By removing the need for re-election or campaigning, our justices are supposed to look objectively at the law and how society has shifted and pass down laws that are rooted in precedence and ensure that we the people's rights are always being expanded – _not stripped!_
**But our current Supreme Court is a _far_ cry from that. **
Steeped in scandals and accusations, the far-right members of the Court have let personal gain and politics rule their every decision. Whether it's overturning the right to an abortion, ending affirmative action, or handing down anti-LBGTQ+ rulings, the Supreme Court is actively harming the people it was created to protect.

body:
Earning the vote in every one of these counties is how we’ll win.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=990%2E552475%2EnUlyJW)
Hey Peter, it’s Bob.
I want to talk to you about my re-election...with the help of my trusted map.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231027-2?refcode=em20231027-2&refcode2=990_552475_nUlyJW&akid=990%2E552475%2EnUlyJW) _I <3 My PA Map_
**When I look at this map, I see home.** Pennsylvania is where I was born, where I grew up, and where my wife Terese and I raised our four daughters. Pennsylvanian families like mine are who I’m fighting for every day.
**When Republicans look at this map, they see an opportunity to take back the Senate.** Mitch McConnell has said so himself — and his hand-picked, mega-millionaire candidate is now running for this seat.
We can’t take anything for granted. My ultra-wealthy opponent, not to mention Republican super PACs, will run attack ads in every county you see on my map — and they could make Pennsylvania the most expensive Senate battleground race of 2024.
The only way to fight back at full strength is with support from people like you.
**[We have to do all that we can to defend this seat and our Democratic majority in the Senate. Will you help my team reach our October end-of-month goal by contributing $5 or more today?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231027-2?refcode=em20231027-2&refcode2=990_552475_nUlyJW&akid=990%2E552475%2EnUlyJW)**

This fundraising deadline is a critical moment to show the GOP that Pennsylvania is not for sale and prepare for the fight ahead.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

_A young Raul Ruiz in Kindergarten, reciting the pledge of allegiance._ **Folks, when I was a kid, I loved to read.

I would read anything I could get my hands on.** Adventure books, comic books, cereal boxes, you name it. As I grew up, I read books that broadened my view of the world, challenged my ideas, and forced me to grow as a person.

I am, in part, the person I am today because of the experiences I gained while reading. I’m more empathetic, more understanding, and more willing to hear someone else’s point of view.

Which is why it terrifies me to see extreme MAGA Republicans all across the country (even in California!) pushing to ban books with just a passing mention of complicated topics or ideas that MAGA extremists find taboo.

Put plainly, team – these MAGA book bans are blatant attacks, not only on the free expression of authors and school children, but adults and society more broadly.

I’m fighting tooth-and-nail against ever increasing MAGA book bans, but we need to snuff out this bigoted movement where it starts –**with the MAGA politicians that fuel the hate and fervor of these movements.**

Adventure books, comic books, cereal boxes, you name it. As I grew up, I read books that broadened my view of the world, challenged my ideas, and forced me to grow as a person. I am, in part, the person I am today because of the experiences I gained while reading. I’m more empathetic, more understanding, and more willing to hear someone else’s point of view. Which is why it terrifies me to see extreme MAGA Republicans all across the country (even in California!) pushing to ban books with just a passing mention of complicated topics or ideas that MAGA extremists find taboo. Put plainly, team – these MAGA book bans are blatant attacks, not only on the free expression of authors and school children, but adults and society more broadly. | | Friend - Congress has a lot of business to attend to, and I am making sure the business of Minnesota’s agriculture communities is “front and center.” [**_[Help Brad Finstad_**](http://links.thelukenscompany.mkt6815.com/els/v2/vZwNBLYaZkh2/cC9PKzl0NjM4c2pzdis2MUF2ZDNDMEZ4MXdXNnJxem1TT1JCczBadjU0VXg4ZVMxTGdHTU05MEh1QWQ1NmY0Q1BrNjRkSjV6T3ArNFdWRWpEWWF0ZzRsUkJ1NnY5cUw5N0txenMwZVR1VW1PNVBsaUd2Q01hUT09S0/)

\- Invests in critical programs for agricultural producers.
\- Strengthens the farm safety net and crop insurance program. Simply put, farm and food security is national security. That’s why I am taking a leading role crafting a Farm Bill that will ensure Americans continue producing the highest quality, lowest cost food, fuel, fiber, and forestry products in the world. [**_Friend, I hope you will stand with me to support our farmers today by chipping in a thoughtful donation of $25, $50, or even $100._**](http://links.thelukenscompany.mkt6815.com/els/v2/mrZkBeGgxZtg/cC9PKzl0NjM4c2pzdis2MUF2ZDNDMEZ4MXdXNnJxem1TT1JCczBadjU0VXg4ZVMxTGdHTU05MEh1QWQ1NmY0Q1BrNjRkSjV6T3ArNFdWRWpEWWF0ZzRsUkJ1NnY5cUw5N0txenMwZVR1VW1PNVBsaUd2Q01hUT09S0/)

| | Within the Farm Bill, I am also pushing for the _**Producer and Agricultural Credit Enhancement Act (P.A.C.E. Act)**_. This bipartisan legislation is aimed at expanding the loan opportunities available to our country’s farmers and ranchers, especially those who are just starting out. The _**Producer and Agricultural Credit Enhancement Act (P.A.C.E. Act)**_ would: \- Increase FSA Guaranteed Operating Loans from $2.04 million to $3 million;
\- Increase Guaranteed Ownership Loans from $2.04 million to $3.5 million;
\- Increase Direct Operating Loans from $400,000 to $750,000; and,
\- Increase Direct Ownership Loans from $600,000 to $850,000. These loans are critical to ensure farms have ready-access to much-needed capital during hard times, but also open doors for expansion, repairs, and updated equipment to remain competitive. [**_SUPPORT OUR FARMERS_**](http://links.thelukenscompany.mkt6815.com/els/v2/WNRaFP3D6pfx/cC9PKzl0NjM4c2pzdis2MUF2ZDNDMEZ4MXdXNnJxem1TT1JCczBadjU0VXg4ZVMxTGdHTU05MEh1QWQ1NmY0Q1BrNjRkSjV6T3ArNFdWRWpEWWF0ZzRsUkJ1NnY5cUw5N0txenMwZVR1VW1PNVBsaUd2Q01hUT09S0/)
At a time when American families are feeling the squeeze of this Biden economy, it’s vital that we still have leaders in Washington willing to shut out the political noise and buckle down to solve problems and get things done. If you support our mission, I hope that you will also support our campaign for re-election in 2024, so that I can continue to serve the great people of southern Minnesota and stand up for our farmers and ranchers. Thank you and God bless you. Brad Finstad

Hi there Friend,

It's Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson.

_**I wanted to reach out and introduce myself because, Friend, I hear you are one of our most dedicated grassroots supporters. **_

I was raised in Shreveport, LA. My father was a firefighter who taught me early the importance of service and sacrifice.

I attended Louisiana State University, where I received a degree in business and later my law degree.

body:
| | | Peter, the Washington Establishment doesn’t like me, and here’s why.... **1.** I called out Mitch McConnell for compromising our conservative values to please the Democrats and Chuck Schumer. **2.** I challenged him for Senate Republican Leader because conservatives deserve a leader that’s going to fight for them, not Washington’s establishment.
I didn’t come to Washington to make friends. This place is BROKEN, and I’m here to fix it.

If I have to call out members of my own party, then so be it.

**[Republicans need to start acting like real Republicans. Do you stand with me?](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=d0c999021db9446390bba9feadbffc20&_e=04hHvLNNS0jNZpe2-1mCc_Jx0Z-1O_k5KUe9jIYBKCORe_N7zCqjSgw1nURpZUKH92J25J_UYcXnMS78nV_SXvEDiSgIUN3UgOSOBJKuCCec_KWMEwVjp2LmQd_nB22lsmWtQzDWGlbSWCLsATLepcS51Pl1uqG7Ar9zFUou2eRTSLo2Ke_D-Bh-jTV7pxRYrTN8T1vcRPKk_Uhvjdc90SMsJq95R1uzB76MG5sYLRvIQpCVZSknC9HIaaUMtD765cQXqMVcvhCyOSJR3hT8Q_Ua3wN5IBeXW-Iovul_OiVwAnNqU53-NmhS8w-l3iGauu8-nHA1zKMTxhWQvZwOxh5YLJbn8l01r7dMOVuSqb7BPtsfSYLD2aS9sPGQQFlx)**

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Climbing back up the cliff
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
I’ve been ringing every alarm bell I can find and calling on Congress to extend emergency child care funding. And the Biden-Harris administration is in this fight, too.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=118%2E4032634%2EPEaaXz)
---
There’s been plenty of chaos coming out of Washington lately. A three-week long quest to find a MAGA GOP House Speaker. A near-shutdown of the government. A loudly ticking clock until the next potential shutdown (less than a month away). But I’m working to make sure another big issue doesn’t get lost in the shuffle: child care. Because, **on October 1, emergency federal funding for child care expired and fell off a cliff.** [**Add your name if you agree that child care funding can’t fall by the wayside, and let’s fight side by side to extend this critical support for families — addressing this short-term crisis while we keep working towards universal child care.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcare/?source=EMZ17C_CHD_E_20231027_V1S1&t=8&akid=118%2E4032634%2EPEaaXz) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcare/?source=EMZ17C_CHD_E_20231027_V1S1&t=9&akid=118%2E4032634%2EPEaaXz)
---
When the pandemic started, I fought alongside Senator Tina Smith to get emergency resources to child care centers across the country.
We won, and it made a huge difference. Funding reached more than eight out of every 10 child care providers nationwide, providing them with enough money to raise wages temporarily for workers without raising costs for parents. That support also meant millions more parents could go to work knowing their children were in good hands.
But House Republicans didn’t lift a finger to extend that funding. Without it, millions of families could have to scramble to find new child care, not be able to go to work, or not be able to take a full shift. And working families who need to arrange child care have barely been hanging on as it is — struggling to preserve houses of cards that could fall apart with just one light breeze. I’ve been there. When I had two little ones and started my first big teaching job, I thought I was going to have to quit, until my Aunt Bee moved in and rescued me, staying for 16 years.
**I’ve been ringing every alarm bell I can find and calling on Congress to extend this funding. And the Biden-Harris administration is in this fight, too.** This week, they’ve requested emergency supplemental funding for child care as an ASAP priority — before the next shutdown deadline. I’ll do everything I can to get this done for families and climb back up the child care cliff.
**But we can’t stop there.** We had a child care crisis in America before the pandemic, and we must take bold action to ensure access for every family in the long run, after addressing this short-term crisis. I’ve got a plan for that. Under my bill, half of all families would pay no more than $10 a day for child care, costs would be capped for everyone, and child care workers would get a raise — recognizing how they do some of the most powerfully important work in the country.
**Universal child care is good for working parents. It’s good for kids who’ll lay the foundation for their education. It’s good for our economy. It’s a win-win-win.**
[**If you’re with me, please add your name to let me know you agree that we must extend critical child care funding. It’s important to show that supporters in your state and across the country are demanding that this is prioritized.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-childcare/?source=EMZ17C_CHD_E_20231027_V1S1&t=10&akid=118%2E4032634%2EPEaaXz)
I’m staying on this — and I know that it’s only possible because I’m fighting alongside people like you.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

| Friend, it is the honor of a lifetime to serve as the 56th Speaker of the House. I’m humbled that my Republican colleagues in the House united behind me as the next Republican Speaker, and I owe everyone who voted for them a debt of gratitude. It’s a debt I intend to repay by being the best servant leader I can be. The Speaker’s gavel is a solemn responsibility, especially in a time like this when the course of history will be set by our actions over the next year. I relied on my faith in God each day before I was Speaker, and I’ll continue to do so each day after. **Scripture is very clear: God is the one who raises those up in authority.** _**I believe that each one of us in Congress has a huge responsibility, to use the gifts that God has given us to serve the people of this great country, for one simple reason; they deserve it.**_ I’m determined to save our country from the powers which seek to destroy it, but I cannot do that alone.

| [ **DONATE NOW** ](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kLGOnTAQRb9m6EBmbOBRUCRBL8VK6VMhgweeVwxmB1to_z4C7aa998jneizvq58_O2h-AuLLuwMQQf8AxI-_J0t657ffOdm3_KP-w9VV4i9AjJ87_Se_HimIrV-vtOkz1-nZKZNRV9btw5jWPNrs1SGaqbKkH64ta2xd3ZazsbOpGmWn2s2Z71ChLhU2qHWJj6Ia9agq02JjXTM3FRh1ewrLJH6y5RFPKxICF1PgbO1eMe7HPewJ-DxoSkLF6TchdxGAz1dIB-VL2PPRxrjSIiFtLp_T5q52GefBhW0IPJAM_J4zDXIM37tAPy2HtEXQfaUAa7kU4rcFdB8lEWCdIg9HSDIR6H6P8hUxOZ8YdD9-J5Pl3fplA93fovvjCvVXHUku_JQyk87tp19Xf9QNGLXcN5gC_wsAAP__FLiN_g)

There are dozens of highly competitive battleground seats that we must win in 2024, or Hakeem Jeffries will take the Speaker's Gavel and immediately go back to business as usual on January 4th, 2025. **Saving our country from the Radical Left is not a small task, and it will require an overwhelming effort from grassroots conservatives from every county in every state.** [**If you’re able, I’d be humbled to have your support.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8kLGOnTAQRb9m6EBmbOBRUCRBL8VK6VMhgweeVwxmB1to_z4C7aa998jneizvq58_O2h-AuLLuwMQQf8AxI-_J0t657ffOdm3_KP-w9VV4i9AjJ87_Se_HimIrV-vtOkz1-nZKZNRV9btw5jWPNrs1SGaqbKkH64ta2xd3ZazsbOpGmWn2s2Z71ChLhU2qHWJj6Ia9agq02JjXTM3FRh1ewrLJH6y5RFPKxICF1PgbO1eMe7HPewJ-DxoSkLF6TchdxGAz1dIB-VL2PPRxrjSIiFtLp_T5q52GefBhW0IPJAM_J4zDXIM37tAPy2HtEXQfaUAa7kU4rcFdB8lEWCdIg9HSDIR6H6P8hUxOZ8YdD9-J5Pl3fplA93fovvjCvVXHUku_JQyk87tp19Xf9QNGLXcN5gC_wsAAP__FLiN_g) _In Liberty,_ Speaker Mike Johnson

subject: Breaking News: 100% Clean Energy in Michigan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC**
body:
Read about my new plan to fight like hell against climate change AND invest in Michigan |
#
---
Friend, For years, scientists around the world have raised increasingly drastic alarms about our rapidly changing climate. And no matter where you live, you’ve almost surely experienced the consequences of a worsening climate. I know we have here in Michigan. Heavy rainstorms are becoming more frequent, and hotter temperatures are harming public health in our cities and the harvests on our farmland. That is why I made fighting like hell against climate change one of my top legislative priorities — **and now I’m proud to say we’re taking action.** Last night, the historic **Clean Energy Future bill package** passed the State Senate — and I can’t wait to sign it. Not only does this bill address the climate crisis, but it also invests in Michigan’s workers and families by: ✅ Making Michigan 100% clean energy by 2040
✅ Protecting our air and water
✅ Improving grid reliability
✅ Lowering energy costs for families
✅ Creating good-paying jobs The Clean Energy Future Package will make Michigan a top clean energy leader, while meeting the urgency of the climate crisis and protecting our land, air and water. It lowers costs for families while creating tens-of-thousands good-paying jobs! **Our clean energy legislation will be a game changer, and it’s all possible thanks to support from supporters like you. But we’ve got to keep going to fight against climate change and lower energy costs for families. clean_body: Read about my new plan to fight like hell against climate change AND invest in Michigan | Friend, For years, scientists around the world have raised increasingly drastic alarms about our rapidly changing climate. And no matter where you live, you’ve almost surely experienced the consequences of a worsening climate. I know we have here in Michigan. Heavy rainstorms are becoming more frequent, and hotter temperatures are harming public health in our cities and the harvests on our farmland. That is why I made fighting like hell against climate change one of my top legislative priorities — and now I’m proud to say we’re taking action. Last night, the historic Clean Energy Future bill package passed the State Senate — and I can’t wait to sign it. Not only does this bill address the climate crisis, but it also invests in Michigan’s workers and families by: ✅ Making Michigan 100% clean energy by 2040 ✅ Protecting our air and water ✅ Improving grid reliability ✅ Lowering energy costs for families ✅ Creating good-paying jobs The Clean Energy Future Package will make Michigan a top clean energy leader, while meeting the urgency of the climate crisis and protecting our land, air and water. It lowers costs for families while creating tens-of-thousands good-paying jobs! Our clean energy legislation will be a game changer, and it’s all possible thanks to support from supporters like you. But we’ve got to keep going to fight against climate change and lower energy costs for families. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | = = | = = | = = A clean, green, and climate-friendly planet is good for us and for our economy. It creates jobs. It lowers costs. It makes us healthier. And it protects the Michigan we know and love. Fighting climate change is no easy task. But I will not back down, and I hope you won’t either. Let’s keep fighting together. Gretchen Whitmer Fight Like Hell PAC PO Box 15093 Lansing, MI 48901 United States ** | mailto:info@fightlikehellpac.org| | Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC
